samples.hyp: Okwekenenya omuwendo gw’okukeberebwa kwa SARS-CoV-2 okwetaagisa okusobola okulwanyisa okusaasaana kw’ekirwadde mu kitundu ekikulu ekya Lusaka mu Zambia nga tunoonya n’abantu abatalaga birala:
Okunoonyereza okwangu mu nkola ya mateeka g’ebyokubala

Obulwadde obuggya obuleetebwa akawuka ka Coronavirus (COVID-19), akaleetebwa akawuka akaleetera obulwadde obw’amaanyi obw’ensonga z’eby’okussa—2 (SARS-CoV-2), mu Afrika kalagibwa n’ekitundu ekinene eky’abantu abatalina bulwadde obweyolefu (oba abalina obubonero obutono) abateeberezebwa okuba n’omugaso mu kusasaanya obulwadde.
Obulungi n’obungi bw’obulwadde obusasaanya mu bantu abatalaga biraga obubonero bukyali tekimanyiddwa bulungi.
Okunoonyereza kyokka kulaga nti okuddukanya kwabwe kuli kikulu mu kuzibira okusasaana kwa SARS-CoV-2.

Tukola ekika ekirambikiddwa eky’enkizo ekya SEIR ekya mateeka okulaba engeri y’okwewala n’okuggyamu abantu abali mu matigga ga SARS-CoV-2 naye nga tebalaga bulwadde, okuyita mu kukema bonna mu Lusaka Province e Zambia okulwanyisa ekirwadde.
Wano twakola ebifaananyi bibiri; (1) nga tukakasa nti abantu abatalina bulwadde obulabika ku 70% ku misango gyonna gya COVID-19 ne (2) abantu abatalina bulwadde obulabika ku 50% ku misango.

Okutwala ekyokulabirako, ekifaananyi kyasooka kukebererwa nga kikakasibwa nti abantu abatalaga birwadde bwe bamu bafaayo nga bwe bali abalala abalina obubonero bw’obulwadde, oluvannyuma, era nga kikakasibwa nti abantu abatalaga birwadde bafayo katono (ekitundu kyakubiri) okusinga abalala abalina obubonero bw’obulwadde.

Ku mulembe ogw’okulowooza nti 70% w’abaana abatalaga bulwadde, omuwendo ogw’ensonda ogw’okugezaako buli lunaku oguli waggulu wa ≥ 7911 ku bantu 100000 gwasobola okukwata obulwadde singa abantu abatalaga bulwadde baba nga balina obusagwa obutono, naye singa obusagwa buba bungi, omuwendo ogw’okugezaako oguli waggulu wa ≥ 10028 ku bantu 100000 gwandibadde gyaetaagibwa.

Ku bitundu 50% eby’abantu abatalaga bulwadde, omuwendo ogutono ogw’okukeberebwa okw’omugatte okusingawo ≥ 4540 okukebera abantu 100000 kyali kimala okwekuuma ekirwadde obutasaasaana ku mutendera gyonna ogw’okumanyisa obulwadde eri abantu abatalaga bulwadde nga bwe guli eri abo abalaga obulwadde.
Okuteesa n'okusomesa

Ekifaananyi kyaffe kiraga nti okwewala abantu abalina COVID-19, nga mw’otwalidde n’abo abatalaga bulwadde, okuyita mu kukeberebwa okwenkanidde ddala kisobola okukozesebwa ng’engeri y’okugema okusasaana kwa SARS-Cov-2 mu Lusaka, Zambia, naye kino kijja kuba n’ensimbi nnyingi.
Okukeberebwa okw'amaanyi mu bibuga binene nga Lusaka kuyinza okukendeeza ku nnamutta ya COVID-19, naye ekyo kisoboka?

Mu 2020, emiwendo gy’ebikola ku byuma bya kompyuta gyalaga nti okusaasaana kwa COVID-19 mu bibuga binene kwandibadde kuyinzika okwekuumira obulungi singa wabaddewo okukeberebwa okw’amaanyi, era nga oluvannyuma abo bonna abaazuulibwa nga balina obulwadde beeyawuddemu.
Naye ng’abanoonyereza bagamba nti enkola eno eyinza okuba ey’amaanyi era nga tekisoboka kukola.
Ku ntandikwa y’ekirwadde kya ssennyiga omukambwe, abantu bangi abaakosebwa COVID-19 tebaalaga bubonero bwa kirwadde naye ne bakyasaasaanya ekirwadde eri abalala.

Ebiwandiiko ebimu byalaga nti 50% okutuuka ku 80% y’abantu abalina COVID-19 tebaalina bubonero (asymptomatic) era bayinza okuba nga baali n’ebivunaanyizibwa ku 40% okutuuka ku 70% y’okusaasana kw’obulwadde obupya.
Abanoonyereza baayagala okumanya oba okuzuula n’okutwala abantu abatalaga bulwadde kuyinza okuyambako mu kulwanyisa okusaasaanira kwa COVID-19.
Baayagala era okumanya oba okukebera abantu bangi mu ngeri etategekeddwa, ekitegeeza okukebera abantu bangi mu ngeri ey’obukyamu, kisobola okuzuula abantu abalina obubonero obutalabika.
Abanoonyereza bakoze ekifaananyi kya kompyuta ekiragula engeri abantu gye bayitamu okuva ku kuba abayinza okukwatibwa, okufuna obulwadde, okufuna obulwadde, n’okwekweka.

Baatunuulira ddala ku byafaayo okuva mu kitundu kya Lusaka mu Zambia, ekifo ekikulu eky’ebyobusuubuzi nga kirina eggwanika ly’ennyonyi erikungaanyizibwa amawanga ag’ebweru era nga kiggya n’ensi bbiri.

Olw’okuba nti eby’obulwadde bwa COVID-19 byalabika nga biyawukana okuva mu kifo ekimu okutuuka mu kirala, baatunuulira eby’okulabirako 4, nga 50% oba 70% y’eby’obulwadde bya COVID-19 tebyalabikanga bulungi, era ebyo byonna byali byanguyirwa oba kitundu ky’ebyo ebirwadde ebirabika.

Ekikula ky’abanoonyereza kyazuula nti kisoboka okwewala okusasaana kwa COVID-19 nga bakola okukebera abantu bonna awatali kusosola era ne bateeka mu kkomera abantu bonna abazuulibwa nga balina obulwadde, n’abo abataliiko bulwadde bwonna obulabika.
Baagamba nti okusobola okukendeeza ku muwendo gwa misango egy’ekikula ekyo ku bitundu 90% mu mbeera zonna, abantu 10% ab’e Lusaka baali beetaaga okukeberebwa buli lunaku.
Era baazuula nti singa twagala okukuuma omuwendo gw’obulwadde bwa COVID-19 obuggya nga tekukyuka, abantu 22% balina okukeberebwa buli lunaku.
Wadde nga Zambia yatandika ebikwekweeto bingi eby’okumalawo COVID-19, ensonga zaali zikyeyongera.
Okukebera abantu bonna kyakendeeza mu ngeri ey’obulungi omuwendo gw’abo abalina COVID-19 ku bitundu 90% mu kibuga kitono mu Italy.
Naye, tewali kunoonyereza kw’edda kulaga nti kyandibadde kikola bulungi mu kibuga kinene ekirala.

Kijjukire nti abanoonyereza tebaakola kukeberebwa kw’abantu bonna mu kunoonyereza kuno; wabula baakola ekyokulabirako ekiraga nti okukeberebwa kw’abantu bonna kyandikola bulungi okuzzaamu ekirwadde kya COVID-19 mu bibuga ebinene.
Naye baalabula nti kyandiba nga kya buseere nnyo.
Baagamba era nti kiyinza okuba eky'amugaso okusingawo bwe kigattibwa n'endala enkola, nga okusiba abantu awaka, okunoonya abo ababadde n'obulwadde, n'okutandika okubakebera.
Abanoonyereza okuva e Zambia era baateekateeka nti ensonga za COVID-19 ezitalaga bulwadde zaali ziwandiikibwa nnyo mu Africa mu kiseera ekyo.
Obutabanguko bwa polygenic scores mu bantu ab’omu Africa olw’enjawukana mu ndagabutonde n’obutonde bw’ensi.
Abantu ab’omu Afrika tebamanyiddwa bulungi mu kunoonyereza ku ndagabutonde naye balina enjawukana ennyo mu ndagabutonde era balina okwetooloola okw’enjawulo okw’ensi yonna.

Kubanga okwekebejja okw’enkola mu kwagula kw’endagabutonde tekunnaba kukolebwa mu nkomerero ezitambulira ku njawulo z’Afrika, twabalirirawo polygenic risk scores (PRS) mu by’okulabirako eby’enjawulo mu Afrika era n’eby’ensoma okuva mu South Africa, Uganda, ne UK okutegeera obulungi engeri endagabutonde zino gye ziyinza okukozesebwa.
Obutuufu bwa PRS bweyongera nga bakozesa ebyokunoonyereza ebikwatagana n’obuwangwa okusinga ebyokunoonyereza ebitalina bwagazi bw’obuwangwa.
Mu bantu ba South Africa ab’enjawulo mu byafaayo n’eby’obuwangwa, tukizuula nti obukakafu bwa PRS buba wansi ku birungo byonna naye ne bujja njawulo mu bibinja.
Enjawukana mu maka ga Afrika ziwera nnyo ku njawulo mu bukakafu bwa PRS okusinga enjawukana endala ezisookerwako wakati w’abantu mu UK ne Uganda.

Tukola PRS mu bantu ab'ennono ya Afrika nga tukozesa okunoonyereza kwa ndagabutonde okw'abazungu bokka okwolekedde okunoonyereza okw'enjawulo mu buwangwa; obungi bw'enjawulo bweyongera okukulaakulanya obutegeevu obusingako ku mutindo gwa hemoglobin n'okusunsula obuwuka obweru mu musaayi, nga bwekikoleka ku ndagabutonde z'ennono ez'amaanyi mu ndagabutonde ezitegeerekeka okuba n'ensonga ku sickle cell anemia n'okuddamu okw'obulabe, buli kimu ku byawandiikiddwa.
Enjawukana mu bwesige bwa PRS mu bantu abava mu maka ag’enjawulo ag’omu Afirika eri nga nnene nga bw’eri mu maka agava ebweru wa Afirika, nga kino kyetaagisa obutegeevu obwenkanankana.
Lwaki tetusobola kwolesa bulungi bulwadde bwa ndagabutonde mu bantu abavuddeko Abantu ba Afirika.
Abanoonyereza bagamba nti engeri ezikozesebwa mu kiseera kino okulagula oba omuntu ajja kufuna obulwadde obuva mu ndagabutonde tezikola bulungi ku bantu ab’ensibuko ya Afrika.
Kino kiva ku nsonga nti eddibuulire eriri emabega w’obunnabbi obwo lisinga okwogera ku ndagabutonde z’abantu abava mu buvanjuba bwa Bulaaya.
Ekitabo kya GWAS kitegeeza “Okunoonyereza ku Nkolagana mu Ndabika y’Endagabutonde zonna”, era abasayansi bakikozesa okunoonya ebika by’abantu n’endwadde nga basinziira ku ndagabutonde.
Mu butuufu, bayinza okukozesa GWAS okubalirira obulabe bw'omuntu obuva mu ndagabutonde eri endwadde oba engeri.
Ebigambo ebisinga eby'endagabutonde mu GWAS, kyokka, biva mu bantu abava mu maka g'Abazungu.

Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baayagala kulaba engeri okubalirira kwe bakozesa okutegeera obulabe obuli mu ndwadde eziva ku ndagabutonde nga bakozesa GWAS bwe kukola ku bantu abava mu buzaale bwa Africa.

Baayagala era okulaba oba ekitongole ekya GWAS ekirimu obuwangaala obusingawo, mu bigambo ebirala ekifuba ekirimu amawulire agawandiikiddwa mu ndagabutonde z’Abafrika abangi, kyandiyambye okutegeera obulungi eby’okulabula.
Okubala kuno kumanyiddwa mu bigambo eby’ebyobuyinza eby’ensi yonna ng’“polygenic risk score”, oba PRS.

Baakozesa kompyuta okubala obulabe obusuubirwa obw’endagabutonde bw’abantu ab’omu Africa nga bakozesa GWAS, era baakozesa ebiwandiiko by’abasawo eby’abantu ab’omu Africa okulaba ku mpisa oba endwadde ezimu ezandiba nga ziva mu nkyukakyuka mu ndagabutonde.

Bwe baakozesa European GWAS, baazuula nti obubonero obwo obulaga obulabe obuli mu ndagabutonde bwali bwesigika nnyo singa abantu baali n’obuzaale bwa Bulaaya okusinga obuzaale bwa Afirika ku bintu bingi.

Baagamba nti obubonero obulaga obulabe buli wansi nnyo wakati w’ebitundu by’Afrika kubanga waliwo enjawukana nnyingi mu bantu, ekitali kyenkanyi n’ebyo bye tulaba ku bantu abava mu bujjuvu bwa Bulaaya.
Era baagamba nti obutegeevu bwa PRS bukula nga ensibuko y’Abafrika ekendeera.
Abantu b’omu Ethiopia baalina obubonero obulungi obw’okuteebereza endwadde eziva mu ndagabutonde kubanga ndagabutonde yaabwe efaanagana nnyo n’endagabutonde y’abantu b’omu Europe.
Bw'okozesa GWAS ey'enjawulo ennyo nga erimu abantu abavuddeko mu Africa, obutegeerekera bw'ebyo ebikolebwa bweyongera okubeera obulungi.
Okulabula endwadde z’omu musaayi kyali kyenkana obulungi nnyo.

Okunoonyereza okw’edda kulaze nti PRS eri wansi ku bantu b’oku lukalu lwa Afirika, nga kitegeeza nti eddibuula lya GWAS ly’ogeraageranya obulabe obutono bw’endwadde z’endabutonde ku bantu abava mu Afirika.
Naye tumanyi nti kino si kituufu bulijjo.

Okunoonyereza kuno kulaga nti ebibalo eby’obulabe obw’akawuka mu ndagabutonde eby’ebbeeyi ya wansi biva ku kuba nti endagabutonde z’Abafirika tezirabikako bulungi mu bubonero bwa GWAS, era nga n’ebibalo bya PRS ebiriwo kati tebisobola kuyamba nnyo mu kulagula endwadde z’akawuka mu ndagabutonde mu Afirika.
Abanoonyereza bagamba nti kyandibadde kirungi okukozesa edatabesi ey’enjawulo ennyo erimu amakubo g'endagabutonde okuva mu bantu abavudde mu kika ky’Abafirika.

Okukola okw’amaanyi kwetagibwa okwongera okusaasaanya GWAS okuyingiza ebyafaayo by’abantu ab’ensibuko y’Afrika, tusobole okuteebereza obulungi engeri y’obulwadde obw’endabirwamu mu bantu ab’omu Afrika.
Abawandiisi b’okusoma kuno baava mu Africa, USA ne UK.
Okukebera Okulaba n’Okukebera Sitoloji mu Kwewala Obulwadde bwa Cervical Intraepithelial Neoplasia n’Akansa ya Kiyumba mu Namibia
Abakyala ababalirirwamu 851,340 mu Namibia bali mu katyabaga k’okufuna obulwadde bwa human papilloma virus (HPV) obusobola okuleeta akawuka akaleeta kankansa ya nsigo.
Okukebera okw’amaaso nga bakozesa acetic acid (VIA) ne cryotherapy byazuulibwa nti bikola bulungi nnyo.
Naye ng’okunoonyereza okulaga engeri empisa z’okukebera obulwadde bwa kkaansa y’ensigo gye zikozeeko kulabika tekuli.
Okunoonyereza kuno kwatunuulira okukeberebwa okw’amaaso n’okukeberebwa kwa cytology mu kuziyiza obulwadde bwa cervical intraepithelial lesions (CIN) n’akawuka k’ensigo mu Namibia.
Ebyazuulibwa byalaga nti abakyala abalina HPV, cervicitis, koilocytosis n'atypia bali mu buzibu obw'amaanyi obufuna ebivudde mu kukebera VIA nga biraga nti balina obulwadde.
Abakyala abakuliridde, naddala abalina akawuka ka HIV, balina obusobozi obusingako okuzuulibwa n’obulwadde bwa squamous cell carcinoma (SCC).

Enkola ya VIA erabika nti esobola okukola bulungi mu kukebera, wadde nga colposcopy mu kugoberera abalwadde mu mbeera y'eNamibia esaanidde okuddamu okulowoozebwako era n'ekozesebwa n'ebizibu bya HR-HPV ebirabika.
Enkola z’okwekebejja ezikwatagana n’okukeberebwa kwa HPV ku myaka egy’enjawulo n’ebibiina eby’obulabe (ng’abalina akawuka ka HIV, obulwadde obulwanyisa omubiri) zikubirizibwa.

Okukozesa ekikola ekikebera kiyinza okwongera okukyusibwa n’okutereezebwa okuyita mu nkola ezikozesa ebyava mu kukebera okw’edda, ebigendererwa by’obulamu bw’abakyala, okumanya okw’ennaku zino n’enteekateeka ezikwatagana n’embeera y’eggwanga.
Abakyala ab’e Namibia abalina obulabe bw’okufuna akawuka ka cervical cancer balina okusunsulibwa n’okufuna obujjanjabi amangu ddala.
Ebitone bingi biyinza okulaga obulabe bw’abakyala obw’okufuna obulwadde bwa kkaansa y’omumwa gwa nsigo, naye okukebera emirundi egikolebwa mu Namibia tekikozesa bulijjo bigezo bino.
Abanoonyereza bagamba nti okwekebeza emirundi egisookerwako, okusobola okuzuula obubonero obulabula nga bukyali, kuyinza okuziyiza abakyala obutafuna obulwadde buno obw’amaanyi.
Endwadde ya kansa ya nsigo (kansa ey’ekitundu ekiri wansi mu lubuto) evaako okufa kw’abakyala bangi mu nsi yonna.
Omu ku misinzi egy’obulwadde bwa kkaansa ya ccervical kwe kawuka ka Human Papillomavirus, oba HPV.
HPV ke kawuka akalwaza ensigo z’omu lubuto, nga kakola ebisago ebiyitibwa lesions, ebisobola okufuuka obulwadde bwa kkansa.
Newankubadde waliwo ddagala eriziyiza HPV, abakyala bangi mu mawanga g’Afrika, nga Namibia okuli, tebalifuna.
Kino kitegeeza nti okukebera akawuka oba obuvune ke kavuddeko kirina obukulu ennyo eri abakyala bano, kubanga kye kimu ku bintu ebisinga obulungi okuyamba mu kuziyiza kensa.
Abanoonyereza mu kunoonyereza kuno bagamba nti amabanja kyebaava galina okuba n’amateeka amatuufu n’amakulu agakwata ku kikebera ekisinga obulungi okukozesa.
Bagamba nti n’abakozi b’ebyobulamu banoonya okufuna obulambe obusingawo ku ngeri ebintu nga emyaka oba obulamu gye bisobola okukosa obulabe omukyala bw’afuna HPV n’akawuka ka kansa.
Banoonyereza ku ngeri etya ebika ebimu ebikozesebwa mu kukebera (ebiyitibwa engeri z’okukebera) bwe byali bikozesebwa okuzuula HPV n’ebiwundu.
Baali n'okwagala okutunuulira engeri ez'enjawulo ez'okukebera, nga ekyokulabirako okukung'aanya ensigo okuva mu lubuto okulaba oba waliwo ebizibu nga bagerageranya n'okunoonya bika.
Baayagala era okumanya oba enjawukana wakati w’abakyala, nga emyaka gyabwe, oba oba baalina endwadde endala nga HIV, kyakyusa obusobozi bwabwe okufuna HPV n’akawuka akaleeta kookolo.
Okumanya amakulu gano kuyinza okuyamba amalwaliro n’ebibiina eby’ebyobulamu okukozesa engeri ez’okukebera mu ngeri ey’obugunjufu.
Abanoonyereza baakebera ebiwandiiko by’abalwadde 214 abakyala abaali bakeberebwa era bafuna obujjanjabi ku HPV, ebisago, ne kensa y’omu kyenda mu ddwaaliro mu Windhoek, Namibia.
Baateeka essira ddala ku kankansa w’omu nsigo mu ntandikwa, ekiseera we kiba nga obulwadde buyinza okuwonyezebwa mangu era n’obutereevu.
Baakung'aanyanga n'ebirowoozo ku myaka gy'omukazi buli omu, ne ku mbeera y'obulamu bwe obwawamu.

Nga banoonyereza ku byawandiikibwa bino, baazuula nti engeri ez’enjawulo ez’okusunsula emirundi mingi zawa abakozi b’ebyobulamu amakubo ag’enjawulo, era nti ziyinza okuba nga ziyamba nnyo nga tebanaba kufuna oba nga HPV ekoze kankansa.
Kansa, nga ekyokulabirako, kyazuulibwanga emirundi mingi nga bakungaanya era ne banoonyereza ku maselo g’omu lubuto.
Ebikosebwa, kyokka, bisobola okuzuulibwa emirundi mingi nga bakozesa okukeberebwa kw’amaaso, nga bakozesa enkola eyitibwa “okukeberebwa kw’amaaso n’acetic acid” (VIA).
Ekintu ekirungi ku nkola eno kiri nti kiyamba abasawo okuzuula ebisago mangu era mu ngeri etali ya buseere.
Kino kivudde ku nkozesa y’ebikozesebwa eby’obujjanjabi ebyangu ebyakozesebwako dda mu kukebera obulamu bw’abakyala, nga speculum (ekyuma ekya metal ekikoledwako okulaba munda mu kisenge ky’omukyala).
Baasanga nti okukozesa enkola ez’enjawulo emirundi mingi kyawanga abaganga obubaka obusingawo ku bubenje bw’omukazi okufuna akawuka ka kkansa, naddala nga bamukebera emirundi mingi.

Okusinziira ku kunoonyereza, abanoonyereza baazuula nti abakyala abakulu, naddala abo abalina akawuka ka siriimu, babeera n’akatyabaga okusinga okufuna obulwadde bwa kookolo, era okubakebera emirundi mingi kisobola okuba ky’amaanyi ennyo.
Abanoonyereza baayongerako nti abakyala abato nnyo be baakolebwako ekikemo kya HPV (nga tebannanoonya bisago) wadde ng’ekikemo kibaddewo.
Okukikola kiyinza okuba engeri y’amaanyi ey’okuzuula endwadde nga tennaba kutuuka wala.

Mu ngeri yonna, baagamba nti ebyava mu kunoonyereza kwabwe byalaga nti waliwo obwetaavu obw’okuteekateeka engeri z’okulwanyisa obulwadde bwa HPV n’akawuka akaleeta kankansa mu nsigo y’omukyala mu ngeri eneyisa obulungi mu Namibia, nga bakozesa engeri z’okukebera ez’etengerera era ez’akabi ennyo okusobola okuzuula endwadde zino mu bwangu.
Okunoonyereza kwali kukolaganira awamu wakati w’abasawo okuva e Namibia ne South Africa.
Omuganyulo gw’obujjanjabi mu bantu abalina HBV/HIV okugeza ku bantu abalina HBV bokka mu kibiina ky’abantu mu South Africa.

Ebyapaaliriza ebigendererwa eby’ensi yonna eby’okumalawo akawuka ka hepatitis B (HBV), twasalawo okutandikawo okunoonyereza ku bantu abalina HBV bokka n’abo abali n’obulwadde bwa HBV/HIV, okukakasa engeri obujjanjabi gye bukosaamu n’okulambula enkyukakyuka mu kujjanjaba kw’ebyobulamu.

Tutegeeza ku byafaayo eby’obugunjufu okuva mu kibiina ekyooleka ekifaananyi ekya bantu abakulu 115 abalina obulwadde bwa hepatitis B obutaleka (CHB), mu ddwaaliro ly’eyunivasite e Cape Town, South Africa.
Okubeerawo kw’obulwadde bwa HIV nga kuyungiddwa kwazuulibwa mu bantu 39 (34%).
Twawandiika ebyafaayo by’abantu eby'omuwendo, eby’eddwaaliro n’eby’olabuleetale.

Bwe tugenjera ku abo abalina obulwadde bwa HIV, abantu abakulu abali n’obulwadde bwa HBV bokka baali tebasobola kuba HBeAg-positive (p=0.01), era tebasobola kuba nga baakolebwa ku bipimo bya elastography (p<0.0001), era tebasobola kuba ku bujjanjabi bwa antiviral (p<0.0001); baali basobola okuba n’obubonero bwa HBV viraemia (p=0.04), era basobola okuba n’obubonero bw’obulwadde bwa kibumba omuli thrombocytopaenia ey’omutawaana/ey’amaanyi (p=0.007), bilirubin eyekulubidde (p=0.004), n’omuwendo gwa APRI ogw’ekulubidde (p=0.02).
Ebizibu bisatu bya hepatocellular carcinoma byonna byava mu kukwatibwa kwa HBV kwokka.

Ebyafaayo byaffe biraga nti abantu abalina obulwadde bwa HBV bokka bayinza okuba n’obuzibu okusinga abo abalina obulwadde bwa HIV, nga kiraga enjawukana ezisobola okubaawo mu kutumibwa, okulondoola n’okujjanjaba.
Abanoonyereza bawadde amagezi okusobola okutereeza eddagala lya hepatitis B.

Mu kunoonyereza kwa munda, abanoonyereza baasobola okulaga engeri okufuna obulwadde bwa hepatitis B (HBV) n’akawuka akalwaza obutaffaala (HIV) gye kiyinza okuwa obuyambi mu bujjanjabi okusinga okufuna HBV yokka.
Mu bukiikakkono bwa Afrika, obulwadde obw’akawuka ka HBV n’akawuka ka HIV ky’ekizibu ekikulu.
Abasawo beetaaga okutegeera engeri akawuka kano n’eddagala erikoleddwa okulwanyisa akawuka kano gye bikolaganamu, basobole okukebera obulungi n'okulabirira abalwadde.
Abanoonyereza baayagala okugeraageranya engeri obujjanjabi gye bukozeeko ku balwadde abaalina HBV bokka, n’abo abaali n’obulwadde bwa HBV ne HIV.
Mu kunoonyereza kuno abanoonyereza baakulonda abalwadde abakulu 115 abaalina obulwadde bwa hepatitis B obw’ekiseera ekiwanvu (CHB).
Baayitibwa okuva mu ddwaliro lya Tygerberg mu Cape Town, South Africa.
Abamu ku balwadde baali balina akawuka ka HIV (39) ate abalala bonna baalina HBV yokka.
Abanoonyereza baalowooza ku kika ky’abantu, emyaka n’eby’obusajja n’obukyala, era ne bakola ebigezo eby’enjawulo eby’ebyobulamu n’eby’ekyuma.

Baazuula nti abalwadde abaalina HBV yokka tebaali basinga kuba ku bujjanjabi bwonna obulwanyisa obuwuka, nga balaga obubonero obwa bulijjo obw'obulwadde bwa ssenyiga (kubanga HBV kyewuka ekisobola okuviirako obulwadde bwa ssenyiga obuzibu).

Abanoonyereza baasobola okulaga nti abantu abaalina HBV bokka baali mu buzibu bw’okugeraageranyizibwa n’abo abaalina obulwadde bwa HIV ne HBV, kubanga abalwadde abaali n’obulwadde bw’ebika byombi baali basobola okufuna eddagala eriziyiza HIV, era nga lino lirina obuyambi mu kulwanyisa obulwadde bwa HBV.

Ebyava mu kunoonyereza kuno byolesa engeri enjawukana mu kusindika, okulondoola n’enkola z’okujjanjaba HBV bweziri bwe gattibwa ku HIV ne HBV okwegatta, ekyo nga kyekyagaliza abo abalina obulwadde bwa HIV ne HBV.
Abanoonyereza baalaze nti tulina okukyusa ne tutandika okuwa obuweereza obulungi era obwenkanya eri abalwadde abali n’akawuka ka HBV kyokka.
Omutawaana gumu ogw’okunoonyereza kuno kwe kuba nti omuwendo gw’abantu gwe baakolako gubadde mutono era nga gwa ggwanga limu lyokka n’enkola zaabwe ez’eddwaaliro.
Ebimu ku bitundu by’eddwaliro ebisobola okuba nga bigenze mu maaso biyinza okulaga endowooza enkyamu bwe bigeraageranyizibwa ku ebyazuulibwa mu kunoonyereza kuno.
Okunoonyereza okw’enjawulo kwetaagisa okukolebwa okusobola okuzuula enjawukana ezazuuliddwa mu kunoonyereza kuno.
Eno kapapula yalaga amaanyi g'okukolagana, nga bannassaayansi abakola ku projeki eno bavudde mu South Africa ne United Kingdom.
Mu kunoonyereza kuno nga tukozesa abantu abalwadde okuva mu South Africa, kituukana n’ekitundu ky’abantu abali mu Africa.
Era ate, okunoonyereza kuno kuyinza okuyambako mu kutumbula enteekateeka z’obujjanjabi ezisingawo obulungi eri abo abalina ekirwadde kya HBV, HIV oba byombi.
Okwekebejja Enkola Za Obutebenkevu Ku Bikolwa By’Obusuubuzi Bwa Bakazi Mu Kitundu Ky’Obwannakyewa Ekya SHIRORO mu Disitulikiti ya Niger.

Okunoonyereza kuno kwetegerezza engeri obutebenkevu gye bukosa emirimu gy’abakyala egy’obusuubuzi mu kitundu kya Shiroro mu Gavumenti Ekitundu kya Niger, nga kisinziira ddala ku nsonga ezikwata ku bwenkanya bw’abakyala mu by’ensimbi, engeri z’emirimu gy’obusuubuzi egyeyolekera mu bo, n’obunene bw’engeri obutebenkevu gye bukosa emirimu gyabwe egy’obusuubuzi.

Ekitundu ky’abakyala 377 kyakolebwa okunoonyereza, ne kireetawo ebyazuulibwa nti abakyala abali mu Shiroro balina obusobozi obungi mu by’obusuubuzi n’obwetwaze mu by’enfuna, era nga bakola nnyo mu SME.

Okunoonyereza kwazuula nti newankubadde obutebenkevu bulina obubonero obubi ku bikolwa by’abakyala eby’okwekolera emirimu nga mu ngeri y’okufiirwa oba okukendeera kw’ensimbi n’ebirala, omuwendo gw’abakyala abakwetaaga emirimu tegukubye mu ngeri eneenye.

Okunoonyereza kwasooka kulaga nti enteekateeka ezirongoosa engeri abakyala gye basobola okufuna n’okukozesa eby’obugagga zirina okutondebwawo era n’ebitongole eby’okukuuma ddembe mu kitundu birina okutondebwawo n’okunywezebwa okulwanyisa obutebenkevu mu kitundu we kwakolebwa okunoonyereza.
Abakyala abakola bizinesi mu Niger beetaaga obukuumi obusingawo.

Abanoonyereza baazuula nti abakazi abakola emirimu gy'obusuubuzi mu Niger bali n'obukugu mu bya byobusuubuzi era nga beeyimiriddewo mu by'ensimbi, naye obukuumi okuva eri babbi kisobola okuba ekizibu.

Abanoonyereza baayagala okumanya obutebenkevu n’obukuumi abakyala abakola emirimu gy’obusuubuzi mu kitundu kya Shiroro mu Gavumenti Enkulu ey’Eggwanga lya Niger gye balina, n’engeri kino kye kiyinza okukosa emirimu gyabwe egy’obusuubuzi n’obwetwaze bwabwe mu byensimbi.
Baabuuzizza abakyala 377 mu kitundu kino ku bizibu bye basanga mu mirimu gyabwe egy’obusuubuzi, okwesigama ku nsimbi, n’okweraliikirira.
Baategeeza nti ebitundu 43% by'abakyala baagamba nti tebali bwegomba ku basajja ku nsonga z’ensimbi, ate ebitundu 32% baagamba nti waliwo abantu abalala abeesigamye ku bo ku nsonga z’ensimbi.
Abanoonyereza era baazuula nti abakyala 85% baali bafuna ssente okuva mu mirimu egy’enjawulo, ate abamu bokka be baagamba nti beesigama ku musaala.
Ebitundu nga 56% baafuna ssente nga bayita mu kulima, ate 79% nga bayita mu buvunaanyizibwa.
Ng’omu ku bakyala 5 yafunanga ssente ng’akola emirimu nga okuwunda enviiri, okusona, okukola obubugo oba okukola emirimu gy’okuwoza engoye.
Abakyala abasinga obungi (91%) baategeeza abanoonyereza nti emirimu gyabwe gyali gyonooneddwa olw’okutya okukwatibwa ababbi n’abamenyi b’amateeka.
Bafiirwa ssente era n’abasajja baabwe olw’okulumbibwa kuno, ekiseera ekirala kibamalako okusigala nga beebalabirira abaana baabwe bokka.
Abakyala era baagamba nti tebalina bumenyi bumala sso ssi nsimbi z’okugaziya emirimu gyabwe.
Abanoonyereza baategeeza nti newankubadde waliwo obuzibu obwo, abakyala b’e Niger baakyalina ebyenfuna ebirungi mu mirimu gyabwe.
Baagamba nti Shiroro yalina abantu ab’enzikiriza n’amawanga ag’enjawulo, era kino kyali kirungi ku by’obusuubuzi.
Okunoonyereza kuno kuleeta okusoomooza ku byazuulibwa by’abanoonyereza abalala abaategeeza nti abakyala balina obuwanguzi butono mu byobusuubuzi olw’okuba nti babeera abeekumiro awaka.
Mu kifo ky’ekyo, abanoonyereza bano bagamba nti obuwanguzi bw’abakazi abakola bizinesi mu kitundu kino ekya Niger businga okukosebwa ennyo obulabe obuva mu bikolwa by’abamenyi b’amateeka n’ababbi.
Abanoonyereza baawagira nti banna byabufuzi bonna balina okukolera awamu okulwanyisa ebintu ebiyinza okulemesa okutuuka ku buwanguzi mu by’obusuubuzi.
Abakyala mu Niger balina okufuna okusingawo obuyambi, amaka g’ebyobulimi n’obukuumi.
Era baalambulula nti abakyala mu byobusuubuzi basobola okutondawo ebibiina ebiyinza okubayamba okulwanyisa ababbi n’abamenyi b’amateeka.

Ebibalo by’omusaayi gw’abakyala abali embuto ebirimu Selenium, Copper ne Zinc mu budde bw’obufumbo bikwatagana n’obulabe bw’okuzala nga tekunnatuuka: Okunoonyereza okw’okukwata n’okugeraageranya okuva e Malawi.
Okuzaala omwana nga tannatuuka mu nnaku 37 z’omwezi.
Okunoonyereza kwakolebwa okulaba enkolagana wakati w’omugatte gw’ebiriisa mu musaayi gwa maama ogwa selenium, copper, ne zinc, n’okufuna embuto mu kiseera ekitali kituufu.
Mu kunoonyereza kuno kwa case-control okwateekebwateekebwa, mwalimu abakyala 181, nga 90/181 (49.7%) baali bafunye embuto ezituukiridde ate 91/181 (50.3%) baali bafunye embuto ezitalituukiridde.

Ekipimo ky’omutindo gwa selenium mu musaayi kyali 77.0; SD 19.4µg/L, copper kyali 2.50; SD 0.52 mg/L ate zinc kyali 0.77; SD 0.20 mg/L nga ebiwandiiko eby’okulabirako biri 47-142µg/L, 0.76-1.59mg/L ne 0.59-1.11 mg/L, buli kimu.
Ebyavaamu biraga nti tewaaliwo kusosoka kwa selenium ne zinc; era waliwo omuggundu omungi gwa copper mu musaayi mu bufumbo.
Okuzaala nga tannatuuka kwali kuli wamu n’okuyitamu omusaayi gw’abakyala omuli ebiriibwa ebiziyiza ebya copper ne zinc.
Obungi bwa zinc, copper, ne selenium ebijjumbirwa n’okuzalibwa kw’abaana mu budde obutali butuufu

Abanoonyereza baazuula omuganyulo omungi gw’ebyokulya ebirimu selenium, copper, ne zinc mu bakyala abaalina abaana abazaalibwa nga tebanatuuka, naye tebannaba kumanya oba omuganyulo guno guva mu mmere gye balya.
Okuzaala ng’embuto terunnaba kutuuka ku wiiki 37 kibaawo omukyala bw’azaala nga tannatuuka ku wiiki 37 ez’obukulu bw’embuto.
Okuzaala mu kiseera ekitali kituufu kuyinza okuleetera omwana obuzibu obw’ebyobulamu okuva ku nsobi mu kutondeka okutuuka ku kufa.
Waliwo ebintu bingi ebisobola okuleetera omwana okuzaalibwa nga tannatuuka, naye obuvunaanyizibwa bw’ebitundu ebito ebisangibwa mu mmere n’obutonde bw’ensi tebinnategeerekeka bulungi.
Ebyokulya bino ebirimu ebintu ebitongole bikulu nnyo mu kukulaakulana kw’omwana, naye abanoonyereza baagala okumanya ekibaawo nga bingi nnyo.

Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baalubirira okuzuula obungi bwa selenium, copper, ne zinc mu bakyala abaafuna embuto ezizaala nga tezituuse, era ne bateekateeka okuzuula emikisa egy’obuzaala obutatuukiridde obuleetebwa obungi obw’amaanyi obwa buli kimu ku mikyala egyanoonyezebwako.
Abanoonyereza baakuŋŋaanya sampolo z’omusaayi okuva mu bakyala 181 nga bamaze okuzaala mu malwaliro abiri mu Lilongwe, ekibuga ekikulu ekya Malawi, wakati wa June 2016 ne March 2017.
Baawerekerayo sampolo z’omusaayi mu kkolero erya Norway gye baaggyako serum, ekika ekirungi ennyo eky’omusaayi, era ne bapima obungi bwa selenium, copper ne zinc.
Nga kitundu kya bakyala 181 abali mu kunoonyereza kuno baazaala nga tebannatuuka mu budde, ate abanoonyereza ne bazuula obungi obusinga obwa selenium, copper ne zinc.

Bwe batyo baakola enkyukakyuka mu kubala kwabwe okusobola okutwala mu nkola ebintu ebirala bingi nga emyaka, obulamu obwawamu, n’ebyafaayo by’okufuna embuto okusobola okulondoola engeri mikulunyo gy’engeri gye gisobola okuleeta okuzaala nga tonatuuka.

Baakomekkereza nti obungi obuwanvu bwa selenium ne copper tebuzannya kintu kikulu mu kuleetera okuzaala mu budde obutali bumativu, naye nti obungi bwa zinc bweyongera obulabe bw’okuzala mu budde obutali bumativu emirundi egisukka mukaaga.
Obungi bwa zaabu obungi kyokka kyali kikulu eri abanoonyereza, olw’ebyokulabirako eby’obutwa ebimanyiddwa.

Okubeerawo kw’abakyala 181 bokka abaatwala omugaso mu kunoonyereza kwakendeeza ku busobozi bw’abanoonyereza okuzuula obulungi ebirina akakwate n’ebizibu ebiva ku bungi bwa selenium obusinga obulungi, kubanga omuwendo ogusinga obulungi gw’abetaba mu kunoonyereza kwe 600.
Emmere y’abetaba mu kunoonyereza gye balya buli lunaku teyanoonyezebwako kulaba oba ng’erimu ebikozesebwa mu bungi obutono obusatu, era n’omuwendo gwa Body Mass Index (BMI) tegwawandiikibwa.
Kuno kwe kunoonyereza okw’olubereberye okw’ekika kino okukima ebikwata ku ngeri selenium, copper ne zinc gye bikosa abakyala abali lubuto mu Malawi.

Afrika erina omuwendo ogusinga ogw’abaana abazaalibwa nga tebannatuuka - okusingawo 18% nga gugerageranyizibwa n’ensi ez’Obusumba ezirina 5%, nga abanoonyereza baagala okumanya oba emmere ennyoonyereza ku nsonga eno.
Okudda awaka, Okukwatirako Ekitundu n'Okukuuma Ekifo ekya Kkobe wa Pancake (Malacochersus tornieri) mu Kenya
Ebikolebwa by’ensolo biraga empisa ez’enjawulo mu kifo n’ebbanga ebyeyongera ku kuwonawo kwazo.
Okutegeera empisa zino kye kimu ku bitundu eby’omugaso ennyo mu kutereka n’okukulembeza obulungi obutonde, naddala ku nsi za buli kika ezirina obulabe.

Mu kunoonyereza kuno, twagezaako okulaba oba amasaaka ga Pancake galina obusobozi bw’okudda awaka singa gasengulwa era ne tunoonyereza ku kwetooloola n’obutonde bw’ekika kino mu bifo byago eby’obutonde mu Kitui County, Kenya.

Empisa za kanyama 39 ezibeera mu mpuku 12 ez’enjawulo ku lwazi zaayigibwa okuva mu July 2020 okutuuka mu June 2022 nga bakozesa okunoonyereza okuyita mu makubo g'amasimu, okukwata ebifaananyi n'okugatta okukebera ku mutendera gw'ekibinja n'okukozesa engeri y'okukima yonna.

Amagongolo kkumi n'ana gaateekebwako ebikozesebwa okusaasaanya amawulire n'okutwalibwa okuva mu bifo byago eby'obujja okubatwalayo mu bifo ebirala ebitali byaabwe era nga okwetambula kwago n'ennono byago byali bikwekebejjebwa.

Ng’ateeka ku bbali abakyala babiri bokka abaagendanga bulungi mu bifo ebiggya eby’okutambuza, amasaaka amalala gonna gagezaako okudda awaka, nga 46.15% ku go gazuula oluguudo okudda mu bifo byago eby’awaka n’obukakafu obutagambika era nga 15.38% nayo gatuuka mu bifo ebikkirizibwa okuba nga biri mu kitundu kyago eky’awaka.
Okuddayo awaka okw’omuganyulo tekutaliganya kulaga obukakafu obw’amaanyi obw’okwagala ekifo mu kika ky’ebitonde.

Okunoonyereza ku mbeera y’okubeeramu kw’emmamba mu mpuku kwalaga nti tewali kyawukana kikulu mu ngeri y’ebyokubala wakati w’emmamba ezaliwo mu mpuku mu kusooka n’omuwendo ogwasangibwa mu nnaku 162 ez’okukuhhaanya sampolo (F(1,22) = 0.0699, P >0.05), era kino kiyamba okukakasa obunywevu bw’okubeerawo mu kifo ekimu mu kika kino.

Ku luuyi olulala, ebikwekweto eby’okukwata ebifaananyi n’okusunsula okw’obwannakyewa byalaga nti ennyonyi ez’amayinja ga Pancake zibeera n’ebyalo, era abasajja b’ennyonyi zino beewakanya nnyo nga bawagira ebyalo byabwe okuva ku basajja abalala abayingira.
Emisota gy’omu nsiko egy’omutawaana gya pancake girina obusobozi obw’ekitalo ‘okuzuula awaka’

Abanoonyereza baakola okuzuula okw’amangu nga banyikiza empisa z’ennyaanya za East African pancake tortoises (Malacochersus tornieri): ensolo zino zisobola okuddamu okuzuula ekkubo ery’okudda awaka nga zimaze okusengulwa mu bifo ebya wala.
Okutegeera engeri n'ensonga lwaki bakikola kino kiyinza okuba eky'omugaso mu kuwonya ebiwuka bino ebirabika katono.
Empisa y’okuzuula amaka gye balaga amatemu gano eyitibwa “homing”, era n’ebisolo ebirala bingi biyinza okukikola.
Okusobola okudda mu bifo ebimu kikwataganya n’ensolo okuddayo eri emmere, bannamwandu, n’obuddukiro, ekintu ekyongera ku mikisa gyazo okubeerawo n’okufukirira.

Newankubadde empisa y’okudda awaka eyayigibwa mu nkula z’ennyanja n’ez’amazzi amalungi, abanoonyereza mu kunoonyereza kuno bagamba nti tukyali n’obumanyi butono ku kudda awaka mu nkula z’ettaka (ebifaanana n’ennyanja).
Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baayagala okutegeera ebisingawo ku mbeera y’embuzi entono ez’enswa mu bifo byazo eby’obutonde ku mayinja agaali mu Kenya.
Baayiga ensolo nga bwe zikwata ne bwe zirya, era n’ekiseera we zigenze okwebaka mu bifo ebikwekeddwa, oba ebinnya mu lwazi.
Abanoonyereza baalondoola ebibinja by’ebyennyanja ebizibika ng’amanda okumala emyaka ebiri, era ne bateekawo kamera okuteekateeka vidiyo y’ensolo bwe zibadde nga tebaziraba.
Era baateekako ebyuma ebisindika amawulire ku bikwata 14.
Bino bye bikozesebwa ebitonotono ebyeyambisibwa abanoonyereza okulondoola ennyingiza z’ensolo, era n’okuketta gye zibeera mu budde obw’emisana n’ekiro.
Abanoonyereza oluvannyuma baatwala emyungu egyo egyabadde gikwatiddwa mu kitundu ekirala, basobole okubinoonyerezaako obulungi.
Mu kutya kw’abanoonyereza, amasaalasala abiri gaatandika okuddayo mu bitundu byago eby’edda, wakati wa kiromita 1 ne 2.5 okuva we baagattibwa.
Kino kye kiseera abanoonyereza lwe baasalawo okwegayirira okutwala ebisolo ebisingawo okuva mu maka gaabyo, okulaba oba byandiyolesa empisa ezifanagana n’ez’okudda awaka.

Ekyewuunyisa, empologoma z’omu nsi nga kitundu kya bibiri ku kimu zaasobola okuddamu okuzuula ebituli bye zaali zisulamu nga tebannaba kusengulwa, era emirundi mingi nga zigenze obuwanvu obusingawo kiromita 1.5 okusobola okutuuka eyo.
Abalala 15% ku bo baasobola okudda mu kitundu eky’obujjuvu, naye tebasobola kusanga ekituli we baali batwaliddwa okuva ku lubereberye.
Abanoonyereza era baazuula nti ebinnya eby'enjawulo bulijjo byalina omuwendo gumu gwa obukalu obuwummulamu, ekiraga nti obukalu bulina ebifo ebimu bye bakozesa okwebaka.

Ebifaananyi ebya kamera byalaga nti amasaawa ga bazzukulu ba kinyonyi baali bakuuma ebifo byabwe, nga kitegeeza nti baali balwana n’abasaawa abalala abagezaako okuyingira ebifo byabwe oba ebinnya byabwe.

Abanoonyereza bagamba nti guno gwe mulundi ogusooka okulaba empisa z’okudda awaka mu bigenge bya pancake, era nga ebyava mu kunoonyereza kwabwe biraga nti ensolo zino zisinga okwagala okubeera n’okuwummulira mu bifo bimu buli lwe kisoboka.
Okunoonyereza kwabwe tekunnanyonyola bazzukulu b’embuzi ennyo bwe baali basobola okuddayo awaka, n’olwekyo okunoonyereza okw’omu maaso kulina kuteeka essira ku kutegeera ekintu kino eky’omugaso.
Olw’okuba ebisolo ebimu oluusi bisobola okusengebwa mu bifo ebiggya olw’okubikuuma, ebyokunoonyereza bino biyinza okuyamba abakola ku by’obutonde okukuuma embatta mu bifo byabyo ebiggya.
Okunoonyereza kuno kwali kukolagana wakati w’abasayansi okuva e Kenya ne China, era kwongera ku kumanya kwaffe ku mbeera y’okuddayo awaka mu bigenge n’ebisolo ebirala.
Ebikolebwa mu musaayi ku nsonga z’okunywa obubonero obw’amaanyi obw’okunywa eddagala lya Rifampicin mu kamwa n’okuliteeka mu muguwa mu balwadde abali n’obulwadde bwa Tuberculous Meningitis:
Okukeberebwa Okutambulira ku Kuteekateeka n’Okulonda mu Kwekenneenya

Ebibalo ebisingawo ebya rifampicin ebiweebwa okuyita mu muguwa biyinza okuteeka mu mbeera ennungi ebyenfuna mu kugonjoola obulwadde bwa meningitis obuleetebwa akawuka ka TB naye tebisoboka mu bitundu ebirimu obulwadde obungi.

Twateebereza nti obungi bwa rifampicin mu musaayi bwandibadde bufaanagana wakati w’okunywa eddagala lya 35 mg/kg w’obuzito bw’omubiri n’okuteekebwamu eddagala mu musaayi lya 20 mg/kg, nga bino byasembebwa okusomesebwa mu kukebera obusobozi mu bulwadde bwa tuberculous meningitis.

Twakola okunoonyereza okwa by'obulamu okwawukanira mu bibinja eby'enjawulo mu nkola ya kafyuulakinetiki nga kuyisibwa mu kukebera okw'ebyobulamu okw'okwongera amaanyi mu bujanjabi obulwanyisa obuwuka obuleeta obulwadde bwa tuberculous meningitis.

Abantu abali ne mukenenya abaalina obulwadde bwa tuberculous meningitis baakunganyizibwa okuva mu malwaliro g’omu South Africa ne bagabanyizibwa mu bibiina bisatu eby’okufuna eddagala erya rifampicin mu bungi obutali bumu:
y'ekigero (okunywa 10 mg/kg), ekigero ekya waggulu (okunywa 35 mg/kg), n'okuyingiza mu muguwa (20 mg/kg).
Okukungaanya ebikozesebwa mu kukebera engeri d’obulamu enyingizaamu eddagala kwakolebwa ku lunaku olwokusatu.
Ebyafunibwa byannyonnyolwa nga bakozesa okunoonyereza okutali kwa bifo eby’enjawulo, era obubonero bwagerageranyizibwa nga bakozesa omugaso gwa geometric mean ratios (GMRs).
Abantu 46 beetaba mu kukung’aanya sampolo za pharmacokinetic (ekigero eky’obuwangwa, n = 17; ekigero ekya waggulu ku kamwa, n = 15; ekya mu muguwa, n = 14).
Omuwendo ogwa CD4 ogwa wakati gwali 130 amaselo/mm3 (ekitundu ekiri wakati [IQR], amaselo 66 okutuuka ku 253/mm3).

Obugazi bwa rifampicin mu kifo wansi w’omugendo gwa budde okuva ku ddakiika 0 okutuuka ku 24 (AUC0–24) bwali 42.9mg · h/ml (95% ekitundu eky’okwesigamako [CI], 24.5 okutuuka ku 75.0mg ·h/ml) ku doozi esookerwako, 295.2mg · h/ml (95% CI, 189.9 okutuuka ku 458.8mg · h/ml) ku doozi ey’omu kamwa ey’amaanyi, ne 206.5mg · h/ml (95% CI, 154.6 okutuuka ku 275.8mg · h/ml) ku kuteekebwa mu muggalo gwa munda.

Rifampicin AUC0–24 GMR yali 1.44 (90% CI, 0.84 okutuuka ku 2.21) era obungi obusingako obw’ekyusa mu musaayi (Cmax) GMR yali 0.89 (90% CI, 0.63 okutuuka ku 1.23) ku miko egy’amaanyi egy’oku mutwe nga gennyigibwa okusinga ku gyo egy’okuyitira mu muguwa.

AUC0–24 ya rifampicin mu musaayi yali waggulu oluvannyuma lw’okukozesa eddagala mu kamwa ku mutendera gwa 35-mg/kg okusinga ku kutandika mu musaayi ng’okukozesa kwa 20-mg/kg mu nnaku ezisooka ez’okujjanjaba mukenenya (TB).
Ebyazuulibwa byawagira okuwa obujjanjabi bwa rifampicin mu kamwa mu kunoonyereza okugenda okujja ku kirwadde kya tuberculous meningitis.
Eddagala eriri mu bujjuvu lisobola okukeberebwa ku balwadde ba siriimu abalina obulwadde bwa TB meningitis.
Abanoonyereza bakkirizza nti kikulu okutandika okukebera oba eddagala erya rifampicin mu bujjuvu liyinza okutaasa abalwadde ba HIV abalina obulwadde bwa tuberculosis meningitis.
Okutuuka ku bantu basatu ku buli bataano abalina akawuka ka HIV era nga bafunye ne obulwadde bwa tuberculosis meningitis bafa olw’akawuka kano, akalumba enkola y’obwongo.
Abalamu baddusibwako ebisago eby’olubeerera ku nkola y’obwongo ey’omu kibuga n’emisuwa egy’omugaso egiva mu bwongo.
Kino kisobola okukosa engeri gye bawulira n'engeri gye beekolamu.
Abamu ku balwadde bafuna okukuba oba okukoonera, oba ebintu ebimu ku maaso gaabwe oba omubiri gubalemera.
Rifampicin, eddagala ery’amaanyi ery’obulabe erikozesebwa okulwanyisa obulwadde bwa pulumooni, bulimu okuweebwa ng’ebirungo okulwanyisa obuwuka obuleeta pulumooni meningitis.
Abalwadde abali mu mbeera mbi ennyo emirundi mingi basanga obuzibu mu kumira amapeera.
Rifampicin esobola okuweebwa n’okuyingizibwa mu muguwa gw’omusaayi mu kifaananyi ky’amazzi.
Olubatu lwegatta mu muguwa gwa mulwadde okusobola omwenge okuyingira mu mubiri.
Tewali kukebera kwonna kunakolebwa kulaba engeri omubiri gw’omulwadde gye gutwala eddagala nga enkola eno ekozeseddwa.
Okufuna obujjanjabi okuyita mu musaayi kyetaagisa ebikozesebwa ebisingawo, okuteekebwa mu ddwaaliro n’omukozi w’ebyobulamu eyayigirizibwa amanyi okutoboza akambe mu musaayi mu ngeri ey’ensonga.
Kino kyekiva kibeera nga tekisoboka mu bitundu ebyetaaga obuyambi obusingako mu nsi yonna.
Abasawo bamanyi dda nti rifampicin teriiko bulungi mu mazzi agali mu bwongo, omugongo n’omu mutwe, eyo we basobola okwekweka obuwuka.
Kyekyo lwaki obungi obusingako bwetaagibwa okusobola okutta obuwuka bwonna mu mubiri gw’omulwadde mu ngeri etuufu.
Naye abanoonyereza baali tebamanyi bulungi obungi bw’eddagala erisobola okuba ery’omugaso era ery’ensimbi.

Abanoonyereza okuva mu South Africa n’omu United Kingdom baayagala kutegeera, nga bakozesa omuwendo mutono gw’abalwadde, obanga kikyamu okuwa eddagala erya rifampicin mu bungi ddala oba nga likozesebwa nga kapusulo oba nga lifulumizibwa mu musaayi, era n’engeri emibiri gyabwe gye giryeyisaamu buli nkola.
Kikulu okutegeera kino nga banonyereza abalala tebannatandika kukola ku kigezo kinene oba okukebera, mwe balina enteekateeka okuwa abalwadde abangi eddagala eringi erya rifampicin.
Omu ku ngeri ssatu ez’okujjanjaba n’ekyuma kya rifampicin yawereddwa abalwadde 46 abali HIV-positive ab’omu South Africa abaalina obulwadde bwa tuberculous meningitis.
Eyasoose yali eddagala ery’obujjanjabi ery’omutindo ery’akapeesa agawa abantu abalwadde, nga buli kkiro omuntu gy’azitoowera afuna rifampicin ya 10mg.
Ekibinja ekirala kyafuna amasaawa agawera ga 35 milligrams ku kiro kya buzito bwa mulwadde.
Ekibinja ekyokusatu kyafuna obukadde 20 obwa milligrams ku kiroogeramu ya buzito bw’omuntu okuyita mu mudumu.
Ekyokulabirako ky’omusaayi kyakwatibwa ku balwadde oluvannyuma lw’ennaku ssatu.
Abanoonyereza baapima nga rifampicin emeka eyali mu plasma ya musaayi gwabwe (ekitundu eky’omumazzi ekya musaayi).
Obungi bwa rifampicin obusinga bwazuulibwa mu mibiri gy’abalwadde abaafuna amacapsule ag’obungi obuwanvu okusinga abo abaafuna obujjanjabi obuyita mu muguwa oba obungi obwabulijjo.
Okugatta kw’ekyuma mu musaayi gwa plasma kwali kufaanagana ku ddozi ey’amaanyi n’obujjanjabi obuyita mu muguwa.
Ebibalo by’ebitongole bino byali waggulu okusinga bwe baali bafuna ddoosi ya bulijjo yokka.
Ng'okusinziira ku banoonyereza, kino kiraga nti obulamu bw'abasawo abali n'obulwadde bwa tuberculosis meningitis busobola okuteekebwa ku mulembe singa bafuna obubonero obusingako bwa rifampicin.
Tekirina makulu oba nga bakifuna mu mpapula oba nga kibayisibwa mu muguwa - ekikulu kiri nti bafuna doozi ezisingawo, kubanga emirambo gyabwe giyinza okukuuma obungi obusingawo bwakyo.
Ebyavaamu bisimbikiza ebyazuulibwa mu kukebera okwakolebwa mu Uganda ne Indonesia.

Ebyokulabirako bibiri ebito mu Indonesia, ku mulundi gumu byalaze nti obulamu bw’abalwadde bangi buyinza okulokolebwa singa bawa eddagala rifampicin mu bujjuvu oba nga balinywa oba nga libasindikirwa mu muguwa.
Naye n’olwekyo, abanoonyereza balabula nti abetabiddwa mu kunoonyereza kuno baali batono okusinga bwe baali basuubira, ekisobola okuleetera ebyavaamu obutaba bya mazima.
Okunoonyereza kwakolebwa mu South Africa.
Kino kiyamba mu nteekateeka y’okukola okunoonyereza okuzuula oba kirungi okuwa abalwadde ba HIV abali n’obulwadde bwa meningitis bwa TB eddagala rifampicin mu bujjuvu.
Kisuubirwa nti obujjanjabi obwo bujja kuwonya obulamu bw’abantu abangi mu Afrika n’awalala mu nsi yonna gy’ensonga ya tuberculosis meningitis eri ekizibu ekinene.
Kozesa wamu komposti ne biochar kisobola okuteekateeka obulungi ettaka erya savanna erikaddiye ennyo?
Okugwa kw’obugimu bw’ettaka kye kimu ku bizibu ebikulu ebiziyiza omutindo gw’ebirime mu sub-Saharan Africa.
Enkozesa ya biochar ne compost ku ttaka okuwunyisa ettaka erimere obulungi kyategeezeddwa abawandiisi bangi.

Mu kunoonyereza kuno, okunoonyereza okw’emyaka 30 mu kifo ky’okukola ebigezo mu kkolero kwakolebwa ng’akozesa sampolo za bukadde 120 buli emu ku Haplic acrisol eyagattibwako biochar ya kasooli (cbio), biochar ya maganda g’omuceere (rbio), biochar ya maganda g’akawunda (coco300 ne coco700) oba komposti ya kasooli (compost); era ne biochar ya maganda g’omuceere eyakolebwa wamu ne komposti (rcocomp) oba biochar ya kasooli eyakolebwa wamu ne komposti (cococomp) ku mutendera gwa 1% w/w ogugattibwa: ettaka, buli emu.

Enkola endala mu kunoonyereza kwali kwegatta kasasiro wa nkoko eyayunguddwa n'obutundutundu bwa kasooli obwokeddwa oba obutundutundu bwa maganda g’omu rice obwokeddwa (1% kasasiro + 1% obutundutundu: 1% ettaka w/w), buli kimu, okulaba engeri gye bikosa okukyusa kw’ettaka, pH y’ettaka; kaboni w’ettaka omuli obuwuka; obusobozi bw’okukyusa ebintu ebirimu amasanyalaze; kaboni omungi mu butonde bwonna, nitrogen omungi ne nitrogen esoboka okutwalibwa mu ttaka.
Biochar ne compost bwe bikozesebwa bokka oba awamu, era n’okuwoomesa biochar byongera pH y’ettaka n’ebyikumi 0.28–2.29 pH okusinga ku ttaka eritalina kyekigattiddwako.

Okussa kw'amasannyalaze okuva mu kasasiro akalimu compost yokka oba ekitole ky'omuceere ekikompebwa, oba biochar okuva ku mizeyituuni oba biochar n'ekisasiro byonna byali waggulu okusinga ekigendererwa ekitakyusiddwa, ekyo nga kiri ku mutendera gumu n'ekyo okuva mu byokozesebwa bya biochar yokka.
TOC mu kasasiro wekka ne mu bujanjalo obw’omuwogo ogw’omugogwa ogw’akolebwa ne kasasiro byali 37% ne 117% waggulu, nga bwe gagerageranyizibwa n’ekikontula.

Okuteekateeka awamu ekikoola ky’omuceere ekikolebwa mu bukalu n’ekomposti kyongera MBC ku bitundu 132% ate nga okwongera ekomposti yokka kyongera MBC ku bitundu 247%, bwe kigeraageranyizibwa ku kitongole.

Mu nkomerero, okunoonyereza kwalaga nti okukozesa komposti nga wekka oba n’okugatta biochar, oba biochar eya komposti kyongera ku mutindo gw’ettaka nga kuyita mu bintu nga pH y’ettaka ne MBC, era kiyamba mu kuteeka ku mirembe C y’ettaka okuyita mu kwongera TOC n’okuggyako okufiirwa kwa C y’ettaka okuyita mu kukozesa obulabe obw’okussa.
Biochar ne compost bitumbula omutindo gw’ettaka ery’okulimirako emmere.

Okunoonyereza kuno kwetegereza engeri biochar, ekintu ekirimu carbon ennyo era ekirimu obugumu obusingako, ekikolebwa okuva ku bintu ebisigaddewo eby’obutonde, gye kisobola okukozesebwa okuteekateeka obulungi ettaka mu bitundu bya sub-Saharan Africa.
Okunoonyereza kwazuula nti biochar eyongera ku mutindo gw’ettaka mu ngeri y’emu nga enkola endala ezisaba ssente nnyingi era ezitali zangu kufuna.
Omu ku bizibu ebisinga obunene ebiziyiza omutindo gw’ebirime mu kitundu kya sub-Saharan Africa kwe kukendeera kw’obugimu bw’ettaka.
Obutonde obulungi bw’ettaka buyinza okuleetera ennimiro okukula obulungi, ekyo nga kiyamba okukendeeza obwavu mu byalo era n’okuzza obutonde bw’ensibo.
Okunoonyereza kulaze nti biochar, ekintu ekirimu carbon ennyo era ekirimu obugumu obusingako, kisobola okukozesebwa okwongera obulungi bw’ettaka.
Ebikolebwa eby’obutonde ebya biochar biva mu kusooka okwaka ebintu ebiri obutonde, oba biomass, nga waliwo empewo entono oba nga tewali mpewo ddala.
Biochar kiraze okulinnyisa obugazi bw'ebibamba by'ettaka, okwongera obungi bw'amazzi n'empewo, n'okutandika ensolo entonotono mu ttaka.

Okunoonyereza kuno kwalongooseza ku ngeri biochar ne compost gye bifunamu ku mutindo gwa ttaka nga bakozesa obubonero nga okussa kw’ettaka, pH y’ettaka, obulamu obutono obuli mu ttaka, obungi bwa kaboni, n’obungi bwa nayitrogeni obuliwo.

Abanoonyereza baakola biochars okuva ku bisu bya kasooli, ebiwata by’enkenene n’ebyoya by’omuceere nga bakozesa pyrolysis, ekitegeeza okusiiga ebintu ebiramu mu butabaamu musaayi, ku 450 °C mu kyuma ekikolebwa wano.
Abanoonyereza baakola biochar okuva mu bukuta bwa njugu mu ngeri ya pyrolysis ku 300 °C ne ku 700 °C.
Abanoonyereza oluvannyuma baateekateeka sampolo z’ettaka nga zikubiddwa wamu ne biochars okumala ennaku 30.

Buli sampolo yalimu ettaka eryateekebwateekebwa obulungi eryayitibwa Haplic acrisol, eryaweebwa omugaso nga likubiddwa wamu n’enjawukana ez’enjawulo ez’ebyochar ezikolebwa mu bikuta by’amasanda, ebiwuuga by’omuceere oba ebiwuuga by’akawunga, n’ebyafaayo bya kasooli eby’okukola komposti.
Ebirala ebipimo byalimu entuuko y’ettaka n’obusa bwa nkoko obw’okuza, n’ensigo za mpunga ez’omuceere, n’ebikuta by’akawunga eby’omuceere, buli kimu.
Buli ku sampolo yali erimu 1% wa compost, 1% ku buli biochar, nga kino kikolebwa abanoonyereza basobole okwekeneenya engeri buli mwevvu eyekolebwa bw’eyinza okukosa omutindo gw’ettaka.

Abanoonyereza baazuula nti okwongerako biochar ne compost ku ttaka, oba nga byawukanye oba nga byetoolodde, kyayongera omuwendo gwa pH ku ttaka okuva ku 0.28–2.29 pH units, nga bwe kigeraageranyizibwa ku ttaka eritalimu bikozesebwa.
Okuyitamu kwa pH kitegeeza nti ettaka lyafuuka lya kweyongera obutaba na kwenkana.

Okunoonyereza kwazuula nti okussa omukka oguli mu ttaka, oba ekitundu ekitono ennyo eky’omukka ogutaliimu buwuka ogufulumya ettaka, kweyongera singa compost yokka yongera, oba singa compost yegattibwa ne kabooko ka muceere, oba biochar ya cob y’akasoli oba biochars ezigattiddwa wamu.

Ebisampulu by’ettaka byalaga okwongera mu bungi bw’amasanyalaze agali mu ttaka ku bitundu 37% nga bakozesa compost yokka, n’okwongera kwa 117% nga bakozesezza corn cob biochar nga gattiddwa ku compost.

Omuwendo gw’ebikolwa by’ebiwuka obutono gweyongera ku bitundu 132% mu ttaka eririmu omugatte gwa compost ne biochar ey’akawuka ka muceere, nga gwegattiddwa ku kweyongera kwa bitundu 247% mu sampolo z’ettaka ezirimu compost yokka.
Ebyava mu kunoonyereza kuno byoleka nti kisoboka okukendeeza obukambwe bw’ettaka nga okozesa biochar, ekisangibwa mu ngeri eyangu era ey’obuwangaazi.
Kino kiva mu nkola endala ey’okuteekamu lime mu ttaka, ekivaamu ensimbi ennyingi era nga tekifuna bulungi ku balimi abato mu sub-Saharan Africa.
Enkula y’Obutoffaali bwa Fibrin obutali bwa bulijjo mu Rheumatoid Arthritis n’Enkolagana yaabwo n’Obulwadde obwekyusa, Obuvune n’Okutumbuka kw’Omusaayi
Obulabe bw’ebintu ebikwata ku mutima n’omusaayi mu balwadde aba RA bweyongera nnyo olw’okwokya omubiri okungi.
Ekyokukosa ekiva ku citrullination ekikwatagana n'okwerwanyisa kw'omubiri ku ntobo n'obusobozi bw'okutumbula okufuna obulwadde bwa fibrin(ogen) kikyali tekimanyiddwa.

Twekebejjezza ebibalo ebyoleka enkola y’emisuwa, obulwadde bw’obukambwe, okukwatika kw’omusaayi n’enkola y’ebikuta bya fibrin mu balwadde ba RA n’abo abali bulungi era ne tusalawo enkolagana wakati w’ebintu ebyo.
Ebyokulabirako by’omusaayi byakuŋŋaanibwa okuva mu balwadde ba RA 30 n’abazirakisa abali mu myaka n’emyaka gy’ekikula kyabwe 25.
Omuwendo gwa SAA, CRP, ICAM-1 ne VCAM-1 gwapimibwa nga bakozesa sandwich immunoassay.
Okugumira kw’omusaayi gwonna kwagezesebwa nga bakozesa Thromboelastography.
Enkola y’amagumba ga fibrin n’enkola y’ebyoya byanoonyerezebwa nga bakozesa Scanning Electron Microscopy.

Okuzuula n’okubala obungi bw’okukyuka kw’ekirungo Citrulline mu bipande bya fibrin ebyakolebwa byakolebwa nga bakozesa akawuka akalina ekirungo ekimanyiddwa obulungi ekya Citrulline awamu n’akazinga ka Confocal Microscopy.
Ebibalo bya SAA, CRP ne ICAM-1 byali waggulu nnyo mu balwadde ba RA nga bagerageranyizibwa n’abali mu kibiina ekirina obulamu obulungi.

Ebirungo bya TEG ebikwata ku kutandika kwa coagulation (R ne K), omuvuduko gw'okwegatta kwa fibrin (α-Angle), n’ebbanga eryetaagisa okutuuka ku kukulaakulana okw'enjawulo kwa thrombus (TMRTG) byakendeera mu balwadde ba RA.
Ebipimo ebikwata ku maanyi g’ekirungo (MA, MRTG, TGG) tebyalina kusikirivu kw’enjawulo wakati wa RA ne bakuuma.

Okukola ku muddumusi gwa logistic regression kwazuula enkolagana ey’amaanyi wakati w’ebikozesebwa mu kiseera ky’obulwadde obw’amaanyi (CRP, SAA) n’ebipimo bya TEG okusinga obubonero obulaga enkolagana y’amannyo.

Okunoonyereza okwakoleddwa nga kuyita mu mikrosikopyo kwalaga emikutu emirimu egy’amaanyi egy’ebitundu bya fibrin ebigazi mu balwadde ba RA okusinga abaali tebafunye bulwadde [ekitundu ekisookerwako (interquartile range) 214 (170-285) okusinga 120 (100-144) nm nga bwekiri, p<0.0001, Odds ratio=22.7).
Okuzuula ebifo ebirala ebirimu citrullinated mu ntobo za fibrin mu balwadde ba RA, ebyali n'obweyolesi obutono mu sampolo ezikontuliro (p<0.05, OR=2.2).
Abalwadde abalina ekirwadde kya RA ekikyakola balaga engeri y’okukakanyaza omusaayi etafaanagana na byazuulibwa ebirala ebigambibwa ku ndwadde endala ezivaamu obulumi.

Okukyusa kwa puloteyini mu ngeri ya citrullination ekwatagana n’akawuka akalwanyisa omubiri kuyinza okuba n’omugaso mu kulaba engeri fibrin gy’ekolebwaamu n’obusobozi obuyinza okuleeta obulabe obw’omusaayi okuziyizibwa mu balwadde ba RA.
Okuzimba kw’omusaayi mu balwadde ba arthritis kuyinza okunyonyola obulabe bwabwe obw’enjawulo eri obulwadde bw’omutima, n’okutulukuka kw’omusaayi mu bwongo.

Okunoonyereza okupya ku ndwadde ya rheumatoid arthritis kuwadde okutegeera okutereevu kw’obusobozi bw’okubaawo enkolagana wakati w’obulwadde buno n’okweyiwa kw’akabi akayinza okuleeta endwadde z’omutima.
Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) kkaalwaliro eriruma era erikosa omubiri nga lyetwala lyokka, nga lyetooloolera n’okukoonakoona mu ngalo n’omubiri gwonna.
Abasayansi bamaze ebbanga nga bamanyi nti abalwadde b’ekirwadde kino balina obulabe obusingawo obwa 50% obw’okufuna endwadde z’omutima n’emisuwa (CVD) – nga okuzirika oba obulwadde bw’omutima.
Ekintu ekikulu ekitwala obulabe kwe kukosa okunyiiga kw’omubiri ku ngeri y’okukwatika kw’omusaayi.
Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abakugu baakebera enkolagana eno, okuzuula ddala lwaki RA eyongera obulabe bwa CVD.
Okumala ddala, abanoonyereza banoonyereza ku ngeri enkyukakyuka mu mubiri ne nkula ezitali za bulijjo bwe bikosa puloteyini ezikwatagana n’okukwata kw’omusaayi, ezo ezimanyiddwa nga fibrins.

Puloteyini zino ziba nga mikutu emiramba egikola “mesh-work” esinga obukulu ku bikwata ku musaayi, n’olwekyo enkyukakyuka ku fibrins zennyini ziyinza okuba n’eby’enkambwe ku nteekateeka y’okukwatagana kw’omusaayi yonna.
Abanoonyereza bagerageranya omusaayi gwa bakyala abalina endwadde ya RA n’ogw’abantu abali bulungi.

Mu buli nsonga, abanoonyereza baali banoonya “obubonero” mu musaayi obulaga obulwadde, wamu n’okunoonya enjawukana ezitali za bulijjo mu nteekateeka y’okukwatagana kw’omusaayi ezisobola okwongera obulabe bwa CVD.
Ebijjanjalo byennyini byanoonyerezebwako wansi w’ekyuma ekitunuulira ebintu ebito, okulaba oba waliwo enkyukakyuka mu ngeri fibrin puloteyini zaabyo gye zitegekeddemu.
Abanoonyereza baalaba nti ebiwanga okuva mu balwadde ba RA byakola amangu okusinga eby’abantu abalamu, era nti n’enfuufu za puloteyini mwe byakolebwa zaali nzito nnyo okusinga fibrins ezisoboka.
Waliwo era enkyukakyuka ku amino acids ezikola puloteyini za fibrin, ezavaako okuzikubiriza okwekolamu okuddamu kw’obutoffaali bw’omubiri, nga kivirako okwongera obulwadde.
Abanoonyereza abalala baalabye enkyukakyuka mu ntobo y’amino acid mu fibrins mu ngalo z’abalwadde ba RA dda, naye kino kye kiseera ekyasooka abanoonyereza okulaba engeri y’emu mu musaayi.

Nga kyegattiddwa ku nkyukakyuka endala ezirabiddwa mu butwa obukwata omusaayi, ebyazuulibwa biyinza okuyamba abasayansi okutegeera obulungi enkolagana wakati wa RA ne CVD, n’engeri y’okuzuula obubonero obusooka obw’obulwadde buno.
Newankubadde ebyavaamu ebyasooka bisuubiza, kyetaagisa okutegeera nti sampolo eyakozesebwa mu kunoonyereza eno yali ntono mu mpisa.

Abanoonyereza era baayogera nti enkola gye bakozesa okuzuula enkyukakyuka mu amino acid mu puloteyini esobola okuba nga yalina ebivudde mu bintu ebitalina kakwate, nga kitegeeza nti okuzuula okw’enjawulo okutuukiridde ku fibrins kyetaagisa okusobola okukkiriza ebyavudde mu kunoonyereza mu biseera eby’omu maaso.

Mu biseera eby’omu maaso, okutegeera enkolagana ez’ekizibu wakati wa RA n’okwongera kw’obulabe bwa CVD kuyinza okuteeka mu maaso eby’enkizo eby’enjawulo eri abalwadde ba RA nga bwe tuyiga okumanya n’okujjanjaba endwadde zino mu ngeri ey’omugaso ennyo.
Abanoonyereza okuva mu South Africa, Denmark ne United Kingdom baali mu kunoonyereza kuno, okwafunibwa ssente okuva mu South African Medical Research Council.
Okubikkulirwa kw’eby’obudde eby’omu nnyanja eri abakozesa ab’oku lubalama – endowooza, okukozesebwa n’okukwatibwa.

Okunoonyereza kuno kuluubirira okutereeza obutakwatagana wakati w’eby’enjigiriza n’abantu mu ngeri y’okutabanguko okw’osobola okubaawo mu kutambuza n’okufuna obubaka obumanyiddwa nga ekituli ky’okukozesa obubaka.
Mu nsonga eno, tukyaliriza obukulu bw’amawulire agakwata ku bumenyi bw’obudde obuli ku nnyanja (metocean) nga bwe gabalibwa abakozesa mu mawanga abiri agali mu kitundu ky’ensi ekya South:
South Africa ne New Zealand.
Wano, ekifuba si kyerekerera ku ndowooza, n’okukozesebwa n’okufuna amakulu ku by’obunnabbi eby’akabi, wabula kisinziira ku kwegatta ku by’obunnabbi ebyabulijjo, ebikolebwa bulijjo.
Okunoonyereza kwakolebwa nga kuyita mu kunoonyereza okwateekebwateekebwa ku bibuzo ebisatu eby’okunoonyereza.

Ebibuuzo eby’okunoonyereza byakwata ku nsonga ezikwata ku by’okulabula eby’omu maaso nga by’eyambisibwa, obutuufu n’obwenkanya, engeri gy’ebikozesebwaamu, erinnya ery’ekitongole, n’obutakakafu obw’akwatagana n’enkyukakyuka z’obudde (nga tuwamu entonotono).
Ebbaluwa ey’okunoonyereza eyateekebwa ku mukutu gwa intaneeti yassaasaanyizibwa nnyo okusobola okutwala abakozesa ab’ebyokwewummuza n’abakola emirimu egy’ebyobusuubuzi.
Okunoonyereza kwasimbiddwa ku kizuula obuwangwa obw’enjawulo obukosa engeri y’okusalawo ey’abakozesa b’ennyanja eziri ku lubalama mu byetaago byabwe eby’amawulire.

Okunoonyereza okw’enkola ya Cultural Consensus Analysis (CCA) kwakozesebwa okunonyereza ku kumanya okw’egattibwa n’enjawukana mu ndowooza mu kitundu kyonna eky’abaddamu ebibuuzo wamu n’emitendera gy’ebyobulamu n’ebyo ebya buli ggwanga.
Twasanga enjawukana mu kutegeeragana mu kibiina kyonna (abantu abetaba okuva mu nsi zombi n’ebitongole byonna awamu) nga bwe kuli n’ebibinja eby’enjawulo eby’abakozesa.

Abetabizi bonna bwe baakwatibwa awamu baalaga okukkiriziganya okwawakati mu by’obuwangwa ku nsonga ezayolesebwa naye nga walimu enjawukana mu ndowooza ku mutendera gwa buli ggwanga, nga kino kiraga obuwangwa obutono obw’enjawulo.

Okwekenneenya ebibinja ebya ggwanga n’ebya byafaayo eby’enjawulo ku bwabwe, twazuula okukkiriziganya okw’amaanyi mu kibiina ky’abakozesa ab’omu South Africa, nga waliwo okukkiriziganya okw’amaanyi nga tewali kusosola mu ngeri y’emirimu.
Ekibinja ky'abakozesa ebyobusuubuzi mu New Zealand kyali tekikkiriziganya nnyo ne bibinja ebirala byonna.
Tunyumyako ebyo ebiva mu byetuzuulidde ku nsonga ez’amaanyi mu kukwatibwa kwa buweereza era n’okukola okulabula okw’amaanyi.
Ebiruubirirwa bingi eby’okukola amagezi agasinziira ku by’obusobozi mu biseera eby’omu maaso nabyo birabikako, nga beetegereza enkyukakyuka ezisuubirwa mu mbeera y’obudde.
Tumaliriza nga tuwa ekifananyi ekiraga engeri y’okukwatagana wakati w’okuteekateeka ebintu eby’okusooka mu kulabula n’obutereevu/obutereevu bw’eby’omumanyi.
Abantu b’omu South Africa ne New Zealand bakkiririza mu bubaka obwogerwako ku mbeera y’obudde ku nnyanja.

Abantu ba South Africa n’aba New Zealand abakolera n’okubeera ku bifo ebiriraanye ennyanja beesigama ku buweereza bw’obunnabbi bw’obudde obwangu okukozesa, era obubawa ebintu ebituufu ebitegeeza ku mbeera y’obudde.
Ebitongole ebikola ku by’obudde eby’eggwanga n’ebitundu ebitali bimu ebikola ku by’obusuubuzi bituwa endagiriro ku bintu ebiyinza okubaawo mu by’obudde.
Bagezaako okuba ab’amazima era nga bayamba ennyo nga bwekisoboka.
Ekitundu kinene eky’ebyobusuubuzi n’eby’okulowooza eby’obusobozi by’eby’omukisa bikozesebwa mu kulagula okwo.

Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baalonda okulaba engeri abantu ab’omu South Africa ne New Zealand gye bakozesaamu eby’okulabula eby’omumaaso – ensi zombi zirina ennyanja empanvu, naye zirina abantu ab’enjawulo nnyo n’eby’obudde eby’oku nnyanja ebitali bimu.

Baayagala kumanya emirundi emeka abantu bano ababeera ku lubalama lwe ggwanga bakozesa eby’obunnabbi eby’eggwanga oba ebya byamaguzi, ku nsonga ki era oba baabifuna nga birungi era nga bisaanidde okwesigibwa.
Bino bye bintu by’omugaso nga tukiririza mu ngeri enkyukakyuka y’obudde ey’omu maaso gye eyinza okukosa okulabula kw’obudde.
Mu buuzo obwali ku mukutu gwa intaneeti, Abantu 31 okuva mu South Africa ne 126 okuva mu New Zealand baawabula.

Bano baalimu abantu abakozesa eby’obudde mu mirimu gyabwe (ng’abavubi n’ebitongole eby’okunoonya n’okulokola), n’abalala abetaba mu mizannyo egyekuusa ku nnyanja n’ebikolwa eby’okusanyukira nga okusefa, okukuba ebigere mu mazzi, oba okuwuga.
Abanoonyereza baabuuzizza ku bwangu bw’okukozesa obuweereza obulondebwa obw’okusooka obw’okulabula ku mbeera y’obudde, n’obutereevu n’obutakyuka kyuka kw’ebyo bye bubuulira.
Abetabizi baayogera ku nsonga ezikifuula eky’omugaso era eky’omuwendo gye bali era ne bagamba oba bino biyinza okukyuka olw’enkyukakyuka z’obudde.
Era baalina okutegeeza oba nga bakkiriza amakulu agabaweebwa eby’obudde ebya ggwanga lyabwe, era n’engeri gye baawuliramu.
Abantu abasinga okuva mu South Africa abaatuula mu kunoonyereza baali baserufa, oba abantu abayingiza mu mirimu gy’okunoonya n’okutaasa oba emirimu gy’okunoonyereza.
Abantu abasinga mu New Zealand abaaddamu ebibuuzo baatunuulira eby’okulabula eby’obudde kubanga baayagala okugenda kuvuba, okusiba eryato oba okusitula eddalu okugenda mu nnyanja.
Abetabizi okuva mu nsi zombi baali bakkiririza mu byafaayo ebyabawaweebwa ebyava mu buweereza bw’eby’obudde obw’eggwanga lyabwe.
Baayagala engeri z’okulabula ezituufu, ezitaliimu kusosola, ezangu okukozesa era nga zirina ebintu ebisobola okukyusibwa okusobola okutukiriza ebyetaago byabwe.
Abantu abetaba mu kunoonyereza abaakozesa obuweereza obwo ku nsonga z’eby’emirimu mu ngeri yonna baazuula nti eby’okulabula ebikwata ku mbeera y’ennyanja okumpi n’omukutu tebyali bituufu bulungi.
Akalombolombo akamu ku bitundu byalimu ebikwata ku bintu obulungi okusinga ebirala.
Abantu ba South Africa baakolanga ku buweereza bw’obudde emirundi mingi okusinga abantu ba New Zealand, era baabukebanga wansi w’emirundi gimu buli lunaku.
Ku bantu 9 ku buli 10 abaddamu, enkola ey’okulabula ennyo yabadde ya mugaso nnyo.
Abasinga baayagala empeereza eyabawa okulaba ebintu ebigenda okubaawo mu nnaku ssatu okutuuka ku musanvu ez’omu maaso.
Abantu abaakola mu kulunda ebyennyanja oba abaali balina okuteekateeka ku nsonga z’ebyokwerinda ezisobola okubaawo baayagala okulabula okw’ebbanga eddene n’okw’omwaka.

Abakozesa abasinga baakikkiriza nti olw’okwongera kw’enkyukakyuka y’obudde, eby’obuweereza eby’okulabula ku biseera birina okukozesa obulungi obusingawo obw’eby’okunoonyereza mu biseera eby’omu maaso okusobola okukakasa okutegeeza obulungi.
Ebyenjiga ebitono nnyo ebyo byakolebwa dda mu nsi eziri mu kitundu eky’Obukiikaddyo.
Abanoonyereza basuubira nti baasobodde okuyiga ebimala okuva mu batuuze nga basinziira ku bibuzo bye bababuuza.
Obunafu obuyinza okubaawo kwe kuba nti abantu bangi ababeera mu New Zealand okusinga abali mu South Africa be beetaba mu kunoonyereza.
Omulimu gwabwe gujja kuyamba abantu abakolera mu buweereza obw’okulabula ku biseera okukola ebintu ebirungi ebikwata ku byetaago by’abakwetaaga.
Bajja kuba basobola okuteekateeka n’okukola enkyukakyuka nga basinziira ku ngeri abakozi baabwe gye basanyukiramu n’ensonga lwaki bakikozesa.
Enkola eyetabamu abantu mu kukebera obuyiiya obulaga obukugu mu by’obulimi obw’enkizo ku mbeera y’obudde:
Omusango gwa Lushoto
Endowooza y’okulima okw’amagezi ku bintu by’obudde (CSA) eri mu kukulaakulana mu nsi yonna.
Naye, tekiraga bulungi biki ebisaana okuteekebwa wansi w'ensibuko zaabyo essatu—obugimu, obumalirivu n'okukendeera.
Bwe kityo, CSA erimu enkola nnyingi ez'enjawulo mu byobulimi/tekinologiya, ekireetera okuba ekizibu okulondamu ebigendererwa bya CSA.
Okusooka, waliwo okusoomoozebwa mu kufuna obulungi obw’enkola n’engeri ezitegeerekeka era ezikola obulungi ez’okukakasa obwongozi bw’embeera z’obudde mu nkola.
Kkumi na biri, amangu ddala tewali bungi bwa kumanya ku ngeri enjawulo ezikolebwa ezizze zibuulirwa nga CSA, naddala mu nsi ezikyeyongera okukulaakulana.
Eky'enkomerero, okussa CSA mu bifo ebikulu tekutwala mu nkola endowooza z'abateekateeka ensonga okulaba ng'ebikolebwa bituukana, bisaanidde era birina obusobozi obw'okukwatibwa amangu.
Wano, tutegeeza ku nkola empya ey’okwenyigira mu kukebera obukugu mu by’obudde mu nkola ezikolebwa mu by’obulimi eby’abalimi abato.
Kino kiraga obubonero (ne mikwatirizo) ku mutendera gwa ffaamu ku nsonga z’ebyokulya n’okugonjoola ebizibu bya CSA.
Kino kiyamba mu kuteekateeka okusalawo ku bipimo, nga kiyamba okukola okunoonyereza okw’olubereberye n’okw’omu maaso ku ngeri y’okwetereeza ku bintu eby’enjawulo eby’amaanyi mu biseera eby’enkya.
Enkola eno yakemebwa mu balimi 72 abakola ku nkola ez’enjawulo ez’okusobola okukyusa obudde mu kyalo ekimanyiddwa nga climate-smart ekya Lushoto, Tanzania.

Abalimi baasinga okusiima enteekateeka ezayamba okuteekateeka ettaka n’okulongoosa engeri yaalyo, okwewala amazi okutwalira ettaka, n’okuddamu okuzza obuggya ettaka eribadde libeera, olw’emiganyulo egyaliwo ku bungi bw’ebirime n’okulima ebirime eby’emyaka egy’enjawulo.
Mu bungi, enkola za CSA zeyongera ku kuzalibwa kw’ensolo, okukola emmere, okulya n’okufuna ensimbi.
Enkola eno kyangu okugikozesa mu bitundu eby’enjawulo n’enkola z’ebyobulimi era ekkiriza okusooka okukola ku byetaago ebikulu.
Naye tusaba nti CSA eyungibwe ku nkola y’okulondoola, okwekaliriza n’okuyiga.
Enkola empya ez’okulondoola ziyamba basayansi n’abalimi okutegekera enkyukakyuka z’obudde.
Abasayansi abakola n’abalimi mu Tanzania kati basobola okukebera engeri enkola empya ez’olimi gye zikola okulwanyisa enkyukakyuka z’obudde.
Baagala nti enkola yaabwe ejja kwongera ku mirembe gy’emmere n’okuwera kw’ebirime eri abalimi mu bitundu ebirala by’ensi yonna.
“Obulimi obukola ku ky’enkuba” kye kimu ku bintu ebyogerwaako Ensi Yonna okuyamba abalimi abato okwetegekera enkyukakyuka z’eby’enkuba.
Omulimi ategeera obudde akyusa enkola ze ng’obudde bukyuka era asobola okwongera ku bwesige mu by’emere nga ayongera ku bungi bw’ebirime bye.
Kino kye kibuuzo ekikulu nnyo eri abalimi b’e Tanzania, kubanga eggwanga lino limaze okusanga ebikungulwa ebitono eby’ebirime ebikulu ebikolebwa mu bibala olw’enkyukakyuka z’obudde.

Naye, abanoonyereza bagamba nti kizibu okukebera obuwanguzi bw'engeri ez'ekyeya ez'amagezi, nga okukozesa ebisumuluzo, era abalimi bo si bulijjo babuuzibwa oba engeri zino zikola nga bwe baali balowooza.

Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abasawo baali baagala kutondeka enkola ey’okupima obuwanguzi bw’ebikolebwa ebikuguka mu by’obudde, nga beeyongedde okussa essira ku kukulaakulanya eby’okulya ebirungi n’okuteekateeka obulungi.
Okutandika, baasoma ebyokunoonyereza ebirala ebikwata ku byobulimi era ne bakola ebiwandiiko bibiri ebirimu ebintu 14, oba "ebikola obubonero", ebikulu mu kupima obukuumi bw'emmere n'okwegendereza.
Olwo, nga bakolera mu Disitulikiti y’e Lushoto mu Tanzania, abanoonyereza baakolagana n’abalimi ab’omu kitundu n’abakugu ab’enjawulo mu by’obulimi okulondoola ebyo ebisinga obukulu ku buli lukalala.
Abalimi baazuula nti okukola emmere kye kimu ku biraga obukulu nnyo mu kukakasa nti emmere eri mu bungi.
Mu ngeri endala, enteekateeka ezonna ezaayamba mu kwongera ku bibala byabwe zaali z’omu muwendo.

Mu kiseera kye kimu, ku nsonga y’okwegendereza, abalimi baali n’okwagala okw’enjawulo mu nkola ezibayamba okukuuma ettaka ly’ebyalo byabwe, n’ezibayamba okwongera ku kutegeera kwabwe, obukugu, n’ensimbi.
Awo abanoonyereza bwe baamala okumanya obukulu bwa buli kimu ku biraga obubonero, baasobola okubikozesa okukebera oba enkola mukaaga ez’enjawulo mu Lushoto zaali n’obuwanguzi.
Mu buli mbeera, baabuuzanga abalimi ab’omu kitundu, ku mutendera gwa 1-5, oba nga waliwo okwongera mu buli kintu okuva lwe baatandika okukola enkyukakyuka.
Ekyo kyabakkiriza okulaba nti enkola ki ku zino ezisinga okuba n’amaanyi ku by’okwerinda eby’emmere n’enkola ez’enjawulo.
Baazuula nti ku nkola 6 ezaakozesebwanga, 3 zokka ze zaalina engeri gye zaakwatibwako.
Ebyo byali okukola komposti, ebika by’ebirime ebirwawo ennyo obunnyogovu, n’okutwala eby’okulya ebirungi eri ensolo z’emmere.
Abanoonyereza bagamba nti enkola yaabwe ekyanguyiza okutegeka nti enteekateeka ez’omu maaso zisobola okutuukiriza ebyetaago by’abalimi b’e Lushoto wamu n’eby’obulimi ebimanya obudde obukyuka.

Bagamba nti okulonda enkola entuufu kwongera ku mukisa ogubaawo nti abalimi bajja kusuubira emize emirungi eri baliraanwa baabwe, bwegutyo ne basasaanya ebirowoozo ebirungi ku bintu ebikola ku mbeera y’obudde.

Mu ngeri enkulu, enkola eno esobola okukozesebwa mu bitundu ebirala, era eyinza okuyambako mu kukakasa nti entegeka ez’eby’obudde ez’amagezi zikwata ku mbeera z’omu kitundu n’amagezi g’abalimi nga bayita mu kulondoola n’okwekeneenya obutayosa.
Mu kukikola, enteekateeka z’ebyobulimi ezitegeerekera ku mbeera z’obudde ziba n’obusobozi obusingako obw’okutuuka ku buwanguzi era ne zifuna okwanirizibwa, mu Tanzania n’ewala mu Afrika.
Okunoonyereza kuno kwali kutuukirizibwa wakati w’abasayansi okuva e Kenya n’e Netherlands.
Eby’obulabe ebiva mu birwadde ebikosa ebitonde ebirina amagumba nga bikwatagana n’ensolo ezitayinzika: Eby’okuyiga okuva mu South Africa
Okunoonyereza ku birwadde ebiva ku binyonyi ebikyamu nga bibeera ku nsi endala tekunafuna kulabirirwa kungi mu kitundu ky’ebyokunoonyereza ku bintu ebiyingirira.
Ebyonoono ebireetebwa ebirwadde biyinza okuba n’eby’obufuzi ku bintu ebiramu, eby’obutonde bye bibeeramu, n’eby’enfuna ebyo ebyobutonde bye byetagisa.

Mu kitundu kino, tukozesa ebyokulabirako by’endwadde ezaleetebwa mu nsolo ez’omu maka n’ez’omu nsiko (obulwadde bwa canine rabies, obulwadde bwa bovine tuberculosis, n’obulwadde bwa rinderpest) n’abantu (smallpox, measles n’akawuka akalwaza obutaffaala, HIV) okulaga engeri endwadde zino gye ziyinza okukosa.

Okukosa okw’amaanyi ennyo okutuusa kati kwali kwa rinderpest, okwavaako okufa kw’ente ez’awamu obuwumbi, era nga kwasaanyeewo ddala ebika ebimu eby’ensolo okuva mu bitundu binene eby’omu bukiikakkono bwa Afrika.
Ekyo kyayongera okukosa nnyo ebyenfuna by’ekitundu, era ne kivirako enkyukakyuka ennene mu nkola n’enkulaakulana y’obutonde bw’ensi.

Rinderpest gyaggibwawo mu nsi yonna, naye obulwadde bwa canine rabies n’obulwadde bwa bovine tuberculosis bikyaliwo, era obulindaala obw’enkessi n’okugikwatako kwe kugenda okubeetaagisa okusobola okubirwanyisa.
Ku ndwadde z’abantu, mukenenya nayo yaggyibwawo mu nsi yonna, naye ekikangabwa ky’ekirwadde kino, ekyaleetebwa abakolonya ab’Abazungu, kyali kya kutuusa obulabe obw’amaanyi.

Mu ntandikwa y'emyaka gya 1700, ekitundu ekinene (okutuuka ku 90% mu bamu ku bibiina) ky’abantu ba Khoekhoe ab'ensikirano baafa, ekintu ekyazikiriza obuwangwa bwabwe n’engeri y’obulamu bwabwe, n’okusigaza abawonyewo abatonotono nga beekoleddeko ng’abakozi ku ffaamu.
HIV, ekyasooka okukizuulibwa mu South Africa mu 1982 nako kyakosezza nnyo era obujjanjabi bwa antiretroviral bwokka kati buleetera gavumenti okusasaanya ZAR 66.4 billion buli mwaka.

Tugattako n’akawuka ka West Nile Virus n’akawuka akaleeta obulwadde bwa African Swine Fever nga ebyokulabirako by’endwadde ezatandikira mu Africa, era nga zisobola okukosa ensi yonna mu biseera eby’omu maaso.
Tulowooza nti endwadde empya zijja kweyoleka nga abantu bwe bagaziya obuwanvu bwabwe mu bitundu eby’omu nsiko, era nga n’obungi bw’ebyamaguzi bwe bweyongera.
Ebikya abasayansi bye bamanyi ku bintu ebitono nnyo ebiyingira omubiri ebyoleka endwadde mu South Africa

Essuula y'ekitabo kino esumulula amakulu agasembyeyo ku ndwadde nga rinderpest, rabies, measles ne HIV, zonna eziva ku butonde bw’obuwuka obuyingirira (viruses, bacteria n’ebitonde ebirala ebitonotono ebitwalibwa ng’ebitonde ebitali bya wano, nga kitegeeza nti tebisangibwa bulijjo mu mbeera y’awamu).
Endwadde zino zonna zikosa ebisolo n’abantu mu South Africa, era obulwadde buno buleetawo akabenje mu by’enfuna by’eggwanga.
Mu kitundu ky’okusoma ekimanyiddwa nga ‘invasive science’, basayansi basoma ku bintu ebiramu ebikula bulungi era ne bikwasa obuzibu nga bimaze okuteekebwa mu bitundu ebipya awatali kubeera bulijjo.
Ebyo ebisinga eby’okunoonyereza byetoolodde ku “bika ebikula ebisusse” nga eby’obulamu n’ebisolo, naye ebitonotono ebiyingira omubiri ne bivaako endwadde nabyo by’omugaso nnyo.
Mu kitundu kino, abawandiisi baayogedde ku bulwadde bwa nsolo n’abantu mu South Africa obuleetebwa obuwuka obutono obutwalibwa.
Baagamba nti ekirwadde ekisinga obulabe kyali "rinderpest," ekyazuulibwa mu South Africa mu 1896.
Rinderpest kyaleetebwawo akawuka era ne kakosa ente n’ensolo ez’omu buserengeto.
Akalwadde ke kamu ke kavuddeko obulwadde bwa measles mu bantu.
Abantu bangi ab’omu byalo baalumbibwa enjala oluvannyuma lw’okutandika kw’ekirwadde mu 1896, naye kati ekirwadde kino kyazikizibwa olw’okugemesa.
Abawandiisi bagamba nti wakati wa 1772 ne 1861, embwa nyingi mu South Africa zaalina obulwadde bwa rabies, wadde ng’abantu tebaali bamanyi bulwadde ki buno.
Mu 1893, kyali kimanyiddwa nti obulwadde bwa rabies buva ku kawuka, kyekyava kibeera nti gavumenti yasalawo okutta embwa ezaali ziweddemu n'okugemesa ezaali teziweddemu.
Naye kino tekyaasa bbwa naddala era kyakosebwa n’ensolo nnyonnyi nga duikers, empologoma, embwa z’omu nsiko, jackals ne foxes.
Abawandiisi bagamba nti mu 1928, abaana 2 baakubwa omusota omumyufu era ne bafa lwa kisimba.
Okuva olwo, obulwadde bwa rabies bwatandika okuba obwawulirwa nnyo mu South Africa.
Baagamba mu 1954, abantu bangi mu South Africa nabo baakosebwa obulwadde bwa measles.
Mu kiseera ekitundu kino we kyawandiikibwanga, amabwa gaali gatta abaana nga 400 buli lunaku.
Baagamba nti omusujja gwa measles gwali gusangibwa mu bungi mu bifo awali abantu n’ente nga bali kumpi nnyo.
Abawandiisi era baayogeddeko ku ndwadde eyitibwa bovine tuberculosis (BTB), ekolebwa obuwuka.
BTB yatta ente, embogo, embizzi z’omu nsiko, empologoma, engo, enkudu, empunu n’emmamba.
Baagamba nti obulwadde bwa BTB bwasooka okwogerwako mu kisaawe kya ggwanga ekya South Africa mu 1996.
Gavumenti yakwata ku ndwadde eno nga ettirawo embogo ezalwala.
Abawandiisi bagamba nti akawuka akalala, akaleetebwa mu South Africa abagenyi okuva mu Yuropu, kaalwaza endwadde eyitibwa 'smallpox' mu bantu.
Obulwadde bwatta abantu ab’ekika kya Khoekhoe abasoba mu 90%.
Ku nkomerero y’ekirwadde ekyo, obuwangwa bwa Khoekhoe bwali buzikiridde ddala.
Abawandiisi era baategeeza ku kawuka akaluma omubiri akamanyiddwa nga HIV akaleeta obulwadde bwa Ssenyiga wa AIDS.
Abasayansi bakyateebereza nti akawuka kaatwalibwa eri abantu okuva mu nsolo, mu nteekateeka eyitibwa zoonosis.
Akawuka kaasooka okuzuulibwa mu South Africa mu 1982.
Baagamba nti, mu mwaka gwa 2019, akawuka ka HIV tekalina kkeesi oba ddagala erigawonya.
Baakomekkereza essuula nga boogera ku kirwadde kya West Nile Virus ne African Swine Fever, bye baayogera nti byava mu Africa ne bisasaana okutuuka mu Europe ne America.
Obulwadde bwa West Nile bwali busindikibwa enzikiza era ne butta ennyonyi nnyingi, naye era bwakosa n’embalaasi n’abantu.
Baagamba nti ebisolo nga embizzi z’omu nsiko n’ez’omu bibira byasindika endwadde ya African swine fever.
Obulwadde bwakosa nguruwe, era bwakosa nnyo emirimu egy’okulunda nguruwe.
Abawandiisi bagamba nti baayogerako ku bulwadde obuleetebwa bakateyamba n'obuwuka, era n'olwekyo essuula eno teriiko byonna ebikwata ku buwuka obuyingira omubiri.
Abawandiisi baali bavudde mu South Africa.
Enkola eyawandiikibwa ku bujulizi ey’okujjanjaba Odontogenic keratocyst.

Okutereeza okw’amaanyi okwa odontogenic keratocyst (OKC) kisigala nga kintu ekirina okwekenneenyezebwa n’okulumwa mu bujjanjabi bw’ennyo n’okukola embulungi mu by’eddagala eby’omu kamwa n’okuva mu maaso.
Kati, waliwo obutakkaanya ku ddagala erisinga obulungi ery’abalwadde abalina odontogenic keratocyst.

Ku ngeri ez'enjawulo ez'okusobola okujjanjaba eziriwo, tewali ngeri n'emu okutuusa kati eyalaze obubonero bw'okutereera obutaddamu kulabikako oba obuli kumpi n'obutaddamu kulabikako okuggyako okusalamu ekitundu ekinene nga waliwo obutundu obuyonjo.

Nga waliwo obutabaawo bungi bw’ebikakafu ebikwata ku nkola z’okulongoosa ezisibuka ku bujjanjabi bw’abalwadde abalina odontogenic keratocyst mu bitabo ebyawandiikibwa, okunoonyereza kuno kuluubirira okulaga enkola ey’okulongoosa, nga esinziira ku byava mu meta-analysis, ebisubirwa okubeera eby’omugaso mu kwongera ku bujjanjabi bw’abalwadde abalina obulwadde buno.

Nga tukozesa ebipimo eby’enjawulo; obunene, ekika ky’ekiwundu (ekikulu oba ekyokubiri), obubonero obulaga obulwadde oba obuweerera bw’ekiwundu, okubeerawo kwa obutuli bwa cortical, n’obubaka obw’enjawulo; twaleeta omuti ogw’okusalawo, okuyambako mu kuteekateeka obujjanjabi n’okuyamba okufuna omukisa ogutono ogw’okuddamu okufuna obulwadde mu kutegeka n’okulongoosa odontogenic keratocyst.
Abanoonyereza balaga engeri ezisingayo obulungi ez'okujjanjaba endwadde z’amu.

Abanoonyereza bwe baakungaanya ebiva mu kunoonyereza okwaliwo, baateekateeka amakubo amalungi agayinza okugobererwa abasawo okuzuula n’okujjanjaba abalwadde abalina obulwadde bw’akamwa obuyitibwa 'odontogenic keratocyst' (OKC).
OKC ky’ekiwundu, oba ekikula ekitali kya bulijjo, ku matama g’omuntu.
Abasawo bazuula nga ekirwadde kino kizibu okujanjaba, era abalwadde emirundi mingi bafuna OKC endala wadde nga bajanjabiddwa bulungi.
Abasawo kati banoonya engeri ez’okuwonya obulabe buno obuli ku matama mu ngeri etuukiridde era ey’olubeerera.
Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baanoonya ku bikolwa ebikulu abaganga bye balina okukola okulambulula n’okujjanjaba endwadde.
Baakikola nga banoonya mu bitabo ebiriwo, oba ebiwandiiko eby’obusobozi, ebikwata ku OKC.
Baali banoonyereza nnyo ku nsonga ezikwata ku ngeri abasawo gye baakolamu ku OKC mu bbanga lya mwaka gumu, nga bwe kyayogerwa mu biwandiiko 46 bye baazuula.

Abanoonyereza baazuula nti OKC yali ebasangibwa nnyo mu basajja okusinga abakazi, era nga eyinza okukosa abantu abali n’emyaka okutuuka ku 90, newankubadde ng’eyali ebasangibwa nnyo wakati w’emyaka 20 ne 30.
Obulwadde bwakosa nnyo ekitundu ky’ensaggu.
OKC etandika munda mu ggumba, nga okuzimba kw’eddiba kuluŋŋamizibwa luvannyuma.
Abalwadde bulijjo bawulira obulumi era babeera n’okusumulukuka (omutindo, nga ngalo, oguva mu kikompe oba ekisago), era emizi gy’amenyo gaabwe gisobola okuva mu kifo kyagyo.
Baawagira nti abasawo basazeewo ekitundu ekirwadde n’amenyo agali okumpi.

Nga bamaze okuggyamu, balina okukozesa eddagala eriyitibwa Carnoy’s solution, wamu ne liquid nitrogen (omutindo ogw’akazimu ogukozesebwa okuggyawo amangu ekikuta ekoneddwa) ne fluorouracil (era nga bamanyi nga 5FU, eddagala ery’obulwadde bwa kkansa erikozesebwa ennyo).
Oluvannyuma lw’okujjanjaba kuno, abakugu mu by’ebyobulamu baawagira nti omusawo alina okubeera n’okukebera obulamu okutuuka ku myaka 25.
Baagamba nti obujjanjabi buno bwali obusinga obulungi ku bisago ebibadde bitono okusinga ekibala kya sitiroberi (3 cm).
Ku bizinga ebisinga obunene obwa 3 cm, abanoonyereza baalangira okussa obwegendereza obusingawo.
Baagamba nti abasawo balina okusooka okukendeeza ekizibu munda mu kikovu n’okuggyamu omusaayi, era n’okuggyawo ebitundu byonna ebiriraanye akamwa.
Ekikole ekyo kisaanidde okukwatibwa n’omutiima gwa Carnoy.
Baawa amagezi nti abasawo balina okulambula bano abalwadde buli myezi ebiri okumala emyaka ebiri.
Singawo omuntu bw’aba n’ebiwundu bingi, abasawo bayinza n’okubikamulamu ebyuma ebikozesebwa mu ddwaaliro.
Naye mu ngeri yonna, okunonyereza okwakeberwa kwalaga nti mu biseera ebisinga, singa abasawo baggyawo ekifaananyi era ne bakozesa 5FU, abalwadde tebaddamu kufuna OKC.
Kyokka baalabula nti obukakafu ku bujjanjabi buno tebulina maanyi bulijjo, era baasanga ebiwandiiko eby'enjawulo ebitono eby'omutindo gw'obusawo ku nsonga eno.

Abanoonyereza nabo tebaakola kigezo kyaabwe kennyini kuyamba ku kunoonyereza kuno; wabula, baagezaako okukuŋŋaanya enkola ezisinga obulungi ez’okujjanjaba okuva mu kunoonyereza okwakolebwa abanoonyereza abalala.
Abanoonyereza bano, abali mu Nigeria ne USA, kyebaava basuubira okunoonyereza okw’enjawulo mu nsi ez’enjawulo okusomesa ku buwanguzi bw’obujjanjabi obulambikiddwa wano.
Era baayamba abasawo okwetegereza embeera endala z’abalwadde mu nteekateeka y’okubajjanjaba.
Entuuka ya SARS-CoV-2 (2019-nCoV), MERS-CoV ne SARSr-CoV: Okukola okwekenneenya okw’enkola ey’enkola ey’okugeraageranya okw’okwawula ebifo ebiyinza okukola obulwadde.
